Apple TVアプリによる情報の使用

Appleは、Apple TVアプリでサービスおよび機能を提供するために、あなたの個人データを使用します。この情報にはアカウントと支払い情報が含まれ、これは“設定”でアクセスおよび変更が可能です。

Appleは、同じApple Accountでサインインしている対応デバイスのApple TVアプリで、あなたが何を購入して視聴しているかについての情報を収集します。この情報は、お使いの対応デバイスで、あなたが何を視聴しているかを表示するために、あなたのApple Accountと関連付けて保管されます。他社製のアプリにサインインすると、あなたが利用できるコンテンツを表示する目的で、これらのサービスのサブスクリプションに登録したどうかについての情報が使用されます。Apple TVアプリに連携する許可を他社製のアプリに与えると、Appleは、すべての対応デバイス上のそのアプリから視聴したものに関する情報、およびサブスクリプションの状況を収集して保存します。Apple MusicやRemoteなどの対応コンテンツを含むAppleのアプリは、TVアプリの使用を開始すると、自動的に連携されます。

あなたが何を視聴しているかについての情報は、再生中のコンテンツ、いつ再生したか、どのデバイスから再生したか、コンテンツのどこで視聴を一時停止または停止したかについての情報も含みます。Appleはさらに、Apple TVチャンネルおよびApple TVのサブスクリプションのすべての再生アクティビティの詳細な履歴も収集します。

Apple TVアプリに位置情報の使用を許可すると、現在地で利用可能なライブの試合、イベント、ニュースなどのコンテンツを提供するためにあなたの位置情報が使用されます。一部のコンテンツには、地理的に関連のある広告が含まれます。

Apple TVアプリの機能改善

Appleは、使用した機能（例: “視聴を再開”、“ライブラリ”）、検索した項目、通知への操作、ブラウズまたは表示したコンテンツページ、アプリ内のエラーやクラッシュに関する情報、請求先郵便番号など、Apple TVアプリの使用状況とアカウントに関する情報を収集します。この情報と、あなたを特定しないおおよその位置情報、およびあなたの視聴に関する情報は、サービスを改善し、最適化する目的で使用されます。また、デバイスの種類、デバイスが取得されたチャンネル、OSのバージョン、デバイスの空き領域などの情報も収集します。この情報は、要求されたコンテンツをダウンロードできるかどうかを判断したり、デバイスの使用状況とストレージの一般的な傾向を把握したり、デバイスがWi-Fiまたはモバイルデータ通信のどちらで接続されているかを確認したりするために使用されます。例えば、デバイスの空き領域の情報は、iPhoneで映画の購入時にダウンロードを不要にする機能を開発するために使用されます。SharePlayを使用してほかのユーザと一緒にコンテンツを視聴すると、Apple TVアプリによって、SharePlayセッション中に視聴したコンテンツ、およびセッションに参加したデバイス数が収集されますが、SharePlayセッションの参加者が特定される情報は収集されません。

Apple TVを強化するモデルを改善するために、Apple TVの検索データが使用されます。 例えば、Apple TVの検索モデルを微調整するために、集約されたApple TVの検索クエリーが使用されます。

Apple TVアプリのパーソナライズ

Apple TVアプリは、あなたと関連性の高いコンテンツを見つけやすくするようにパーソナライズされます。例えば、これまでにあなたが視聴した映画に基づいてあなたの好みに合う可能性のある映画をおすすめしたり、Apple TVアプリでのアクティビティに基づいて、より関連性の高い検索結果を提供したりします。Appleは、パーソナライズの目的で、あなたの視聴履歴、購入、サブスクリプション、ダウンロード、検索、ブラウズ、およびその他のApple TVアプリでのアクティビティなどに関する情報、および年齢などのアカウントからの情報を使用します。

Apple TVアプリに対応するすべてのデバイスで、パーソナライズを行う目的でAppleがこのデバイスのApple TVアプリでのあなたの視聴に関する情報を収集しないようにするには、“設定”で“再生履歴を使用”をオフにできます。iOS、iPadOS、visionOS、またはtvOSデバイスでは、“設定”＞“アプリ”＞“TV”＞“再生履歴を使用”に移動します。MacのApple TVアプリで、“TV”＞“設定”＞“再生”に移動してから、“閲覧履歴を使用”の選択を解除します。

お使いのApple Accountの“パーソナライズされたおすすめ”をオフにすると、App Store、Apple Books、iTunes Store、Apple TV、Apple Podcasts、およびAppleのサブスクリプションのパーソナライズ機能をオフにすることができます。iOS、iPadOS、またはvisionOSデバイスでは、“設定”＞[自分の名前]＞“メディアと購入”＞“アカウントを表示”に移動し、“パーソナライズされたおすすめ”をタップしてオフにします。

情報の送信

Appleは、Apple TVアプリや、Apple Oneを含む、あなたが関心を持つ可能性のあるその他のApple製品、サービス、およびオファーに関する情報をあなたに送信するために、所有しているApple製品、Appleサービスへのサブスクリプション登録、ダウンロードしたAppleのアプリ、請求先郵便番号などのあなたのアカウントに関する情報を使用する場合があります。お使いのデバイスに関する詳細（シリアル番号など）または関連するApp Storeのサブスクリプションに関する詳細がAppleからのオファーの資格を確認するために使用される場合があります。ファミリー共有グループのメンバーである場合は、Appleからファミリー共有で利用できる製品、サービス、オファーに関する情報が送信されることがあります。Apple Oneサブスクリプションを購入すると、サブスクリプションに登録した各サービスの機能に関するメールと通知が送信される場合があります。Appleはまた、あなたのApple TVアプリ内でのアクティビティに関する情報を使用して、Apple TVアプリで利用可能な新機能、コンテンツ、およびオファーに関するメールおよび通知を送信する場合があります。account.apple.com にアクセスして、メール設定を変更し、これらのメールの受信を解除することができます。iOS、iPadOS、またはvisionOSデバイスで通知設定を更新するには、“設定”＞“通知”＞“TV”に移動してください。

広告

Apple TVアプリでは、Apple TVに位置情報へのアクセスを許可した場合、地理的に関連のある広告を提供するために位置情報が使用される場合があります。

その他のApp Store、Apple News、“株価”などのアプリでは、“パーソナライズされた広告”設定がオンになっている場合、Appleの広告プラットフォームによって、より関連性の高い広告をこれらのアプリで提供するためにあなたの個人情報（Appleから購入した映画やテレビ番組についての情報など）が使用される場合があります。

Appleの広告プラットフォームから、あなたの興味関心に基づいたターゲティング広告を受け取りたくない場合は、“パーソナライズされた広告”をオフにすることを選択できます。“パーソナライズされた広告”をオフにすると、Appleは広告ターゲティングにあなたの情報を使用できなくなります。これにより、受信する広告の数が減るとは限りませんが、広告があなたと関連性の低いものになる可能性があります。

“パーソナライズされた広告”の設定は、“設定”＞“プライバシーとセキュリティ”＞“Appleの広告”で変更できます。

Appleの広告とプライバシーについて詳しくは、www.apple.com/jp/legal/privacy/data/ja/apple-advertising を参照してください。

App Store、Apple News、および“株価”でパーソナライズされた広告の配信を停止する方法について詳しくは、support.apple.com/105131 をご覧ください。

パートナーを介したApple TVのサブスクリプション

ご契約の携帯電話会社がApple TVのサブスクリプションや無料トライアルをご案内した場合、Appleでは、提携先の携帯電話会社を通じてお客様が条件を満たしているかどうかを判断するため、お客様の電話番号を調べることがあります。Apple TVのサブスクリプションや無料トライアルを携帯電話会社またはAppleの別のパートナーを通じて登録いただいた場合、Appleでは、お使いの電話番号またはパートナーによって共有される一意のアカウント識別子を使用して、アカウントを確認し、お客様がサブスクリプションをアクティベートしたことを携帯電話会社またはその他のパートナーに通知します。サブスクリプションに関連付けられている電話番号や一意の識別子は、サインイン時のアカウント確認と、Apple TVのサブスクリプションをアカウントに対応付ける目的で使われます。

パートナーのプラットフォームでApple TVのサブスクリプションコンテンツを視聴できるように、そのパートナーを通じてApple TVのサブスクリプションを購入した場合、そのパートナーは、Apple TVアプリでもApple TVのサブスクリプションコンテンツを表示できるようにパートナーのアカウントとApple Accountを接続することを許可する場合があります。パートナーのアカウントを接続することを選択すると、Appleはパートナーのアカウントに関する特定の情報を受け取りますが、Appleが保存するのは、パートナーIDとApple TVのサブスクリプション状況のみです。

第三者との共有

Appleは、Appleと連携しながらAppleの製品およびサービスを提供したり、Appleのマーケティングに協力したり、Appleの代わりに広告を販売してApp Store、Apple News、および“株価”に表示したりする広告主や戦略的パートナーに、個人を特定しない一部のデータを提供します。例えば、Appleは、あなたのお支払い、視聴アクティビティ、地域に関する個人を特定しないデータ、およびユーザ層に関する集約統計（Apple Accountの名前や挨拶で使用される呼びかけなどの情報から推測されうる年齢層や性別など）をApple TVの戦略的パートナー（コンテンツオーナーなど）に提供する場合があります。これらのデータは、アプリやコンテンツのパフォーマンスを測定したり、ロイヤルティや課金の要件を満たしたり、関連する製品/サービスを改善したりするために使用されます。

Apple製品以外のデバイスでApple TVアプリにサインインする場合、Appleは、アプリを機能させるため、Apple TVサブスクリプションからのコンテンツがプラットフォーム上に表示されるように、また、検索結果の提供やパーソナライズされたおすすめなどのプラットフォームの機能に対応するために、プラットフォームプロバイダと情報を共有する場合があります。これには、あなたがApple TVアプリを開いたかどうか、および使用可能な場合には、Apple TVやApple TVチャンネルにサブスクリプション登録しているかどうかについての情報が含まれる可能性があります。Apple製品以外のデバイスのApple TVアプリでサブスクリプション登録情報の共有をやめることを選択できますが、そのプラットフォームでのApple TVのコンテンツの表示方法が制限される可能性があります。

対応するApple製品以外のデバイスで、Apple TVのサブスクリプション、Apple TVチャンネル（利用可能な場合）を含むApple TVアプリでの視聴/購入/レンタル内容を他社製プラットフォームのプロバイダと共有するかどうかを選択できます。これには、あなたのプロフィール名、またはTVアプリのデータをApple製品以外のデバイス上のアカウントやプロフィールと照合するために使用されるその他の情報が含まれる可能性があります。プラットフォームのプロバイダは、Apple TVアプリからの情報を使用して、視聴中の番組やパーソナライズされたおすすめの表示などのプラットフォーム上の機能を有効にする場合があります。これは、Apple製品以外のデバイスではApple TVアプリ設定に移動してオフにすることができます。一部のデバイスでは、プラットフォームの設定に移動する場合があります。

Apple製品以外のデバイスでApple TVアプリにサインインする場合、プラットフォームプロバイダの利用規約、プライバシーポリシー、および運用を確認して、どのようにデータが収集/使用/共有されるかを理解してください。

保持

Apple TVアプリでの購入、ダウンロード、および視聴アクティビティに関連付けられる個人データは、ビジネスのニーズ、契約上の義務、および法的必要条件に応じて、さまざまな期間で保持されます。購入とダウンロードについて、多くの場合、保持期間は最低10年ですが、中国などの地域では30年になる場合があります。Appleは、適用規約に従ってユーザがコンテンツをダウンロードできるようにするために、少なくともユーザがストアのアカウントを所有している間、コンテンツの購入およびダウンロードの記録も保持します。また、ブラウズや検索などに関する情報も最大で2年間保持します。保存されたクレジットカード情報を除くご利用明細など、一部の情報は、ユーザがアカウントを削除したあとやApple TVアプリの利用を停止したあとでも、取引記録として保持される場合があります。

支払い用カードを使用すると、今後の購入や定期的な購入や承認済みのその他の使用に備えて、Appleはカード番号と請求情報を保持し、自動的にアップデートする場合があります。Appleは金融機関または支払いネットワークからこの情報を取得し、不正行為防止と確認の目的で使用します。

再生履歴の消去

Apple TVアプリの再生履歴は“設定”で消去することができます。iOS、iPadOS、またはvisionOSデバイスのApple TVアプリでは、“アカウント”＞“再生履歴を消去”に移動します。tvOSでは、“設定”＞“アプリ”＞“TV”＞“再生履歴を消去”に移動します。これにより、すべてのテレビ番組および映画がウォッチリストから削除され、過去の再生履歴のアカウントとの関連付けが解除されます。これは、同じApple Accountを使用するデバイスでAppleが保持/使用するあなたの再生データに適用されます。Apple製品以外のデバイスを使用し、プラットフォームプロバイダと視聴内容を共有することを選択している場合、再生履歴を消去してもプラットフォームプロバイダによって保存されている再生データには影響しません。プラットフォームプロバイダの利用規約、プライバシーポリシー、および慣行を確認して、プロバイダによって保存されているデータを削除することができるかどうかについて理解してください。

エピソードを長押しして“ウォッチリストから削除”を選択すれば、ウォッチリストから項目を個別に削除することもできます。“最近視聴した作品から削除”を選択すれば、削除された項目はパーソナライズされたおすすめの生成に使用されなくなります。ただし、報告およびロイヤルティの要件により、Apple TVチャンネルおよびApple TVのサブスクリプションからの再生履歴の記録は保持されます。

連携済みの他社製アプリ

連携可能な他社製アプリをApple TVアプリに連携し、それらのアプリで視聴したものをAppleと共有するには、各アプリに許可を与えなければなりません。Apple TVアプリを設定すると、一度に複数のアプリケーションに許可を与えるよう求められる場合があります。まだデバイスにインストールしていないアプリについても、あとでそれらをインストールすると環境設定が適用されます。許可を与えるかどうかにかかわらず、各アプリの環境設定は“設定”で変更できます。

他社製のアプリをApple TVアプリに連携しないようにする場合、そのアプリとApple TVアプリの連携を解除すれば、Appleはその他社製アプリからの再生情報の収集を停止します。iOS、iPadOS、またはvisionOSデバイスのApple TVアプリでは、“アカウント”＞“連携済みのアプリ”へ移動し、他社製アプリを選択してオフにします。tvOSでは、“設定”＞“アプリ”＞“TV”＞“TVに連携”へ移動し、他社製アプリを選択してオフにします。Apple TVアプリから他社製アプリを削除するときは、“削除して再生履歴を消去する”を選択して、Appleがすでに収集したそのアプリで視聴したコンテンツに関する再生データ情報も削除するように選択することもできます。上述のとおりに再生履歴を消去して、Appleがすでに収集したApple TVアプリで視聴した他社製アプリのコンテンツに関する再生データ情報を削除するように選択することもいつでも可能です。ここで述べられている再生履歴の消去は、AppleがApple TVアプリ用に保管・使用する他社製アプリの再生データだけを消去します。他社製アプリプロバイダによって保管されている再生データ（例: 他社製アプリ内または他社製サーバ上）には影響しません。

連携可能な他社製アプリの条件・規約、プライバシーポリシー、慣行・慣例も併せて確認し、再生データおよびそれに関連する情報がどのように使用および共有されるか理解してください。

グループのおすすめ

Apple TVデバイスでグループのおすすめを有効にすることを選択した場合は、同じApple TV上の同意を得たユーザの組み合わせでグループのおすすめを作成するために、あなたが視聴したものに関する情報が使用されます。グループ内にお子様のアカウントがある場合、子供向けのおすすめが含まれますが、お子様の視聴履歴は使用されません。“設定”＞“ユーザとアカウント”と選択し、自分のプロフィールを選択して“メンバー全員”を選択することで、自分のアカウントに対するグループのおすすめをいつでもオフにできます。

不正行為およびその他の悪意のある活動の防止

Appleは、Apple TVアプリでの不正行為およびその他の悪意のある活動を防ぐためにも、個人データを収集します。この情報には、デバイス情報（デバイスの種類、ソフトウェアのバージョンなど）、位置情報（利用可能な場合、インターネット接続のIPアドレスを地理的な地域と照らし合わせることで推定されたおおよその位置）、ダウンロードおよび購入履歴、Apple TVアプリでのその他の操作が含まれます。サブスクリプションが自動更新に設定されると、AppleはAppleとの過去のビジネス関係に関する情報を使用してリクエストを処理し、支払いパートナーによる承認に先立ってサブスクリプションへの継続的なアクセスを提供するかどうかも決定します。

また、Appleは、あなたが購入を試みたときに、送受信した通話やメールのおおよその回数などのデバイスの使用状況に関する情報を用いて、デバイスのトラストスコアをデバイス上で計算する場合があります。送信データは、Appleがデバイスのこれらの基になる情報を把握できないように設計されています。デバイスのトラストスコアはAppleのサーバ上で一定期間保管されます。

個人データを処理する際に適用される法的根拠

Appleは通常、お客様との契約を履行するため、サービスを提供するために必要な範囲で、法的義務を遵守する目的において、Apple TVアプリ内の個人データを処理します。お客様の同意が適切な法的根拠となる場合は、該当する現地法に基づいて同意を求めます。

該当する現地法で定められている場合、Appleは、Appleまたは第三者の正当な利益のために、必要に応じて、以下の目的で個人データを処理します:

• あなたが利用できるコンテンツ、およびあなたと関連性が高いコンテンツを表示すること（他社サービスのコンテンツを含みます）
• オファーの資格を確認する、お客様とその他のユーザへのサービスの向上および最適化に役立てる、Apple TVアプリや、あなたが関心を持つ可能性のあるその他のApple製品、サービス、およびオファーに関する情報を送信すること
• 不正行為およびその他の悪意のある活動の防止

使用するデータには以下が含まれます:

• Apple TVアプリの使用状況（使用した機能（例: “視聴を再開”、“ライブラリ”）、検索した項目、通知に対する操作、ブラウズまたは表示したコンテンツページ、視聴、購入、サブスクリプション登録、およびダウンロードしたもの、アプリ内のエラーやクラッシュに関する情報など）
• デバイスとアカウントに関する詳細
• デバイスのトラストスコア
• 位置情報

いかなる場合においても、Appleが収集する情報はAppleのプライバシーポリシー（https://www.apple.com/jp/privacy を参照）に従って取り扱われます。

The Apple TV app allows you to watch your favourite TV shows and movies all in one place. You can watch content you have rented or purchased from Apple. If available, you can also access content through your Apple TV subscription, Apple TV channels and your connected third-party video apps. You can access all this content through the Apple TV app across supported devices that are signed in to the same Apple Account.

Providing the Apple TV App

We use your personal data to provide the services and features in the Apple TV app. This information includes your account and payment information, which you can access and change in Settings.

Apple collects information about what you purchase and what you’re watching in the Apple TV app on any supported devices signed in to the same Apple Account. Apple stores this information associated with your Apple Account so we can display what you’re watching across your supported devices. When you sign in to third-party apps, information about whether you have subscribed to those services is used to display content available to you. If you grant permission for a third-party app to be connected to the Apple TV app, Apple will collect and store information about what you watch from that app on any of your supported devices, as well as your subscription status. Apple apps with supported content, such as Apple Music and Remote, will be automatically connected when you start using the Apple TV app.

Information about what you’re watching will include what content you’re playing, when you played it, the device you played it from and where in the content you paused or stopped watching. We also collect a detailed history of all playback activity for Apple TV channels and your Apple TV subscription.

If you allow the Apple TV app to access your location, your location will be used to determine what’s available in your region, including local content like live games, events and news. Some content includes geographically relevant ads.

Improving the Apple TV App

Apple collects information about your usage of the Apple TV app and your account, including the features you use (for example, Continue Watching or Library), items you search for, your interactions with notifications, content pages you browse or view, information on errors or crashes within the app, and your billing pin code. We use this information, approximate location information that does not identify you and information about what you watch to help improve and optimise the service for you and others. We also collect information about your device such as the type of device, the channel through which your device was obtained, the version of your operating system and the amount of free space on your device. We may use this information to assess whether requested content can be downloaded, to understand general trends in device usage and storage, and whether your device is connected over Wi-Fi or mobile data. For example, knowing the free space on your device allowed us to build the feature that lets you buy a movie on your iPhone without downloading it at purchase. If you use SharePlay to watch content with other users, the Apple TV app will record that you watched that content during a SharePlay session and the number of devices that participated in the session, but will not collect any information to identify the participants of the SharePlay session.

We use Apple TV search data to improve models that power Apple TV. For example, aggregate Apple TV search queries are used to fine-tune the Apple TV search model.

Personalising the Apple TV App

We personalise the Apple TV app to help you discover the content that’s most relevant to you. For example, we recommend movies we think will be of interest to you based on movies you’ve previously watched, and we provide more relevant search results to you based on your activity in the Apple TV app. To provide personalisation, we use information including what you watch, your purchases, subscriptions, downloads, searches, browsing and other activities in the Apple TV app, as well as information from your account such as your age.

If you do not want Apple to use information about what you watch on this device in the Apple TV app for personalisation on all devices that support the Apple TV app, you can turn off Use Play History in Settings. On your iOS, iPadOS, visionOS or tvOS device, go to Settings > Apps > TV > Use Play History. In the Apple TV app on Mac, go to TV > Settings > Playback, then deselect Use Viewing History.

You can turn off personalisation features in the App Store, Apple Books, the iTunes Store, Apple TV, Apple Podcasts and for subscriptions from Apple by turning off Personalised Recommendations for your Apple Account. On your iOS, iPadOS or visionOS device, go to Settings > [your name] > Media & Purchases > View Account, then tap to turn off Personalised Recommendations.

Communicating with You

Apple may use information about your account, such as the Apple products you own, your subscriptions to Apple services, the Apple apps you download and your billing pin code, to send you communications about the Apple TV app and other Apple products, services and offers that may be of interest to you, including Apple One. Details about your device, such as its device serial number, or details about your relevant App Store subscriptions may be used to check eligibility for Apple offers. If you are in a Family Sharing group, Apple may send you communications about products, services and offers available to you through Family Sharing. If you purchase an Apple One subscription, we may send you emails and notifications about the features of each of the services to which you have subscribed. Apple may also use information about your activity within the Apple TV app to send you emails and notifications about new features, content and offers available in the Apple TV app. You can change your email preferences and opt out of receiving these emails by going to account.apple.com. To update notification preferences on your iOS, iPadOS or visionOS device, go to Settings > Notifications > TV.

Advertising

In the Apple TV app, if you allow the Apple TV app to access your location, your location may be used to serve geographically relevant ads.

For other apps such as the App Store, Apple News and Stocks, if the Personalised Ads setting is turned on, Apple’s advertising platform may use your information, including information about the movies and TV shows you purchase from Apple, to serve ads in those apps that are more relevant to you.

If you do not want to receive ads targeted to your interests from Apple’s advertising platform, you can choose to turn off Personalised Ads. Turning off Personalised Ads will prevent Apple from using your information for ad targeting. It may not decrease the number of ads you receive, but the ads may be less relevant to you.

You can change your Personalised Ads settings by going to Settings > Privacy & Security > Apple Advertising.

Learn more about Apple Advertising & Privacy at apple.com/in/legal/privacy/data/en/apple-advertising.

Learn about how to opt out of personalised ads on the App Store, Apple News and Stocks at support.apple.com/105131.

Apple TV Subscriptions Through Partners

If your mobile network provider offers Apple TV subscriptions and free trials, Apple may check your phone number to determine whether you are eligible through a mobile network provider partner. If you sign up for an Apple TV subscription or free trial through your mobile network provider or another Apple partner, Apple will use your phone number or a unique account identifier shared by the partner to identify your account and to let the mobile network provider or other partner know that you have activated your subscription. We will use the phone number or unique identifier associated with your subscription to verify your account at sign-in and to connect your Apple TV subscription with your account.

If you purchase an Apple TV subscription through a partner that enables you to watch Apple TV subscription content on their platform, the partner may allow you to connect your partner account and your Apple Account so you can also view Apple TV subscription content in the Apple TV app. When you choose to connect your partner account, Apple receives certain information about your account with the partner, but Apple stores only your Apple TV subscription status along with a partner ID.

Sharing with Third Parties

We provide some non-personal data to our advertisers and strategic partners who work with Apple to provide our products and services, help Apple market to customers, and sell ads on Apple’s behalf to display on the App Store and Apple News and Stocks. For example, we may share non-personal data about your transactions, viewing activity and region, as well as aggregated user demographics such as age group and gender (which may be inferred from information such as your name and salutation in your Apple Account), to Apple TV strategic partners, such as content owners, so they can measure the performance of their creative work, meet royalty and accounting requirements, and improve their associated products and services.

If you sign in to the Apple TV app on a non-Apple device, Apple may share information with the platform provider to enable the app to function, so that content from your Apple TV subscriptions appears on the platform, and to support platform features such as providing search results and personalised recommendations. This may include information about whether you have opened the Apple TV app and, where available, whether you have subscribed to Apple TV and Apple TV channels. You can choose to stop sharing your subscription information in the Apple TV app settings on your non-Apple device, although doing so may limit the ways that Apple TV content appears on the platform.

On supported non-Apple devices, you can choose whether to share what you watch, buy or rent in the Apple TV app, including your Apple TV subscription, Apple TV channels and other content (where available), with the provider of your third-party platform. This may include your profile name or other information used to match your data from the Apple TV app with your account or profile on your non-Apple device. Your platform provider may use your information from the Apple TV app to enable platform features such as displaying the shows you have in progress and personalised recommendations. You can turn this off by going to the Apple TV app settings on your non-Apple device. On some devices, this may direct you to the platform’s settings.

If you choose to sign in to the Apple TV app on a non-Apple device, you should review the terms, privacy policies and practices of the platform’s provider to understand what data it collects, uses and shares.

Retention

We retain personal data associated with your purchases, downloads and viewing activity on the Apple TV app for different lengths of time depending on business need, contractual obligations and legal requirements. For purchases and downloads, that often requires at least a 10-year retention period, but in regions such as China, that period can be 30 years. We also retain a record of your purchases and downloads of content for at least as long as you have an account with us to allow you to download that content in line with our applicable terms. We retain other information such as browsing activity and searches for up to two years. Some information, such as transactions but not your stored card details, may be retained as business records even after you close your account or stop using the Apple TV app.

When you use a payment card, Apple may retain and automatically update your card number and billing information for future purchases, recurring transactions or other uses you authorise. Apple may obtain this information from your financial institution or payment network and also use it for fraud prevention and verification.

Clear Play History

You can clear your play history in the Apple TV app in Settings. In the Apple TV app on your iOS, iPadOS or visionOS device, go to Account > Clear Play History. On tvOS, go to Settings > Apps > TV > Clear Play History. This will remove all TV shows and movies from your Watchlist and disassociate any past playback history from your account. This will apply to your play data that is held and used by Apple on devices that use the same Apple Account. If you use a non-Apple device and have chosen to share what you watch with that platform’s provider, clearing your play history will not affect the play data that is stored by the platform’s provider. You should review the terms, privacy policies and practices of the platform’s provider to understand whether you can delete the data stored by that provider.

You can remove individual items from your Watchlist by touching and holding the episode and selecting Remove from Watchlist. In the same menu, if you select Remove from Recently Watched, that will also remove the episode from being used to generate personalised recommendations. However, Apple will retain records of play history from Apple TV channels and your Apple TV subscription for reporting and royalty requirements.

Third-Party Connected Apps

You must grant permission for your participating third-party apps to be connected to the Apple TV app to begin sharing what you watch from those apps with Apple. When you set up the Apple TV app, you may be asked to grant permission for multiple applications at one time. Some of the apps may be apps that you do not yet have installed on that device, and your preferences will be applied if they are installed later. Whether or not you grant permission, you will be able to change your preferences for each app in Settings.

If at any time you decide you no longer want one of your third-party apps to be connected to the Apple TV app, you may disconnect that app from the Apple TV app and Apple will stop collecting your play data from that third-party app. In the Apple TV app on your iOS, iPadOS or visionOS device, go to Account > Connected Apps, select the third-party app and turn it off. On tvOS, go to Settings > Apps > TV > Connect to TV, select the third-party app and turn it off. When removing a third-party app from the Apple TV app, you may also choose to delete all play data information Apple has collected about content you’ve watched from that app by choosing the Remove and Clear Play History option. At any time, you may also choose to delete all the play data information Apple has collected about all third-party content you watch in the Apple TV app by clearing your play history as described above. Clearing your play history in any of these described instances only clears your third-party app play data that is held and used by Apple for the Apple TV app. It does not affect any play data that is held separately by the third-party app provider (for example, within their own app or on their servers).

You should also review the terms, privacy policies and practices of your participating third-party apps to understand how they use and share your play data and related information.

Group Recommendations

If you choose to enable Group Recommendations on an Apple TV device, information about what you watch will be used to make group recommendations with any combination of opted-in users on the same Apple TV. If a child account is in the group, recommendations for children will be included, but their viewing history will not be used. You can turn off Group Recommendations for your account at any time by going to Settings > Users and Accounts, selecting your profile, then selecting For All of You.

Preventing Fraud and Other Malicious Activity

We also collect personal data to prevent fraud and other malicious activity in the Apple TV app. This information includes device information, such as device type and software version, location information (approximated by matching the IP address of your internet connection to a geographic region, if available), download and purchase history, and other interactions with the Apple TV app. When your subscription is set to auto-renew, Apple may also use information about your historical business relationship with Apple to process the request and determine whether to provide ongoing access to your subscription in advance of authorisation by the payment partner.

We may also compute a device trust score on your device when you attempt a purchase, using information about how you use your device, including the approximate number of phone calls or emails you send and receive. The submission is designed so Apple cannot learn the underlying values on your device. The score is stored for a fixed time on our servers.

Applicable Legal Basis for Processing Personal Data

We process your personal data in the Apple TV app generally for performance of your contract with Apple, as necessary to provide the service and to comply with our legal obligations. Where consent is the appropriate legal basis, we seek it in accordance with applicable local law.

Where applicable local law provides, we process personal data as necessary for purposes of our legitimate interests or those of a third party in order to:

• Display available and relevant content to you, including from third-party services
• Check eligibility for offers, help to improve and optimise the service for you and others, and send you communications about the Apple TV app and other Apple products, services and offers that may be of interest to you
• Prevent fraud and other malicious activity

The data used includes:

• Your use of the Apple TV app including features you use (for example, Continue Watching or Library), items you search for, your interactions with notifications, content pages you browse or view, what you watch, purchase, subscribe to and download, and information about errors or crashes within the app
• Details about your device and account
• The device trust score
• Your location

At all times, information collected by Apple will be treated in accordance with Apple’s Privacy Policy, which can be found at www.apple.com/in/privacy.

Aplicația Apple TV vă permite să vizionați într‑un singur loc emisiunile TV și filmele favorite. Puteți să vizionați conținutul pe care l‑ați închiriat sau achiziționat de la Apple. În funcție de disponibilitate, puteți accesa conținut și prin intermediul abonamentului dvs. Apple TV, al canalelor Apple TV și al aplicațiile video terțe conectate. Puteți accesa tot acest conținut prin intermediul aplicației Apple TV pe toate dispozitivele Apple compatibile care sunt autentificate în același cont Apple.

Furnizarea aplicației Apple TV

Utilizăm datele dvs. personale pentru a furniza serviciile și funcționalitățile din aplicația Apple TV. Acestea includ informații despre cont și plată, pe care le puteți accesa și modifica în Configurări.

Apple colectează informații despre ceea ce achiziționați și ce vizionați în aplicația Apple TV pe oricare dintre dispozitivele dvs. Apple compatibile autentificate în același cont Apple. Apple stochează aceste informații în asociere cu contul dvs. Apple, pentru a putea afișa ceea ce vizionați pe toate dispozitivele dvs. Apple compatibile. Când vă autentificați în aplicații terțe, informații care denotă dacă v‑ați abonat sau nu la serviciile respective sunt utilizate pentru a afișa conținutul disponibil pentru dvs. Dacă îi acordați unei aplicații terțe permisiunea de a se conecta la aplicația Apple TV, Apple va colecta și stoca informații despre conținutul pe care îl vizionați din aplicația respectivă, de pe oricare dintre dispozitivele dvs. compatibile, precum și starea abonamentului dvs. Aplicațiile Apple care oferă conținut compatibil, precum Apple Music și Telecomandă, vor fi conectate automat atunci când începeți să utilizați aplicația Apple TV.

Informațiile despre ceea ce vizionați includ ce conținut redați, când l‑ați redat, dispozitivul de pe care l‑ați redat și momentul în care ați suspendat sau oprit vizionarea conținutului. De asemenea, este colectat un istoric detaliat al activității de redare pentru canale Apple TV și abonamentul dvs. Apple TV.

Dacă permiteți ca aplicația Apple TV să vă acceseze localizarea, localizarea dvs. va fi utilizată pentru a determina ce conținut este disponibil în regiunea dvs., inclusiv conținut local precum jocuri live, evenimente și știri. O parte din conținut include reclame relevante din punct de vedere geografic.

Îmbunătățirea aplicației Apple TV

Apple colectează informații despre modul în care utilizați aplicația Apple TV și contul dvs., inclusiv funcționalitățile pe care le utilizați (de exemplu, secțiunea Continuați vizionarea sau biblioteca), articolele pe care le‑ați căutat, interacțiunile dvs. cu notificările, paginile de conținut pe care le explorați sau vizualizați, informații despre erorile sau blocajele din aplicație și codul dvs. ZIP de facturare. Aceste informații, informațiile despre localizarea aproximativă care nu vă identifică personal, precum și informațiile despre ceea ce vizionați, sunt utilizate pentru a îmbunătăți și optimiza serviciul pentru dvs. și pentru ceilalți utilizatori. Sunt colectate informații despre dispozitivul dvs., precum tipul dispozitivului, canalul comercial prin care a fost obținut dispozitivul, versiunea sistemului de operare și cantitatea de spațiu liber de pe dispozitiv. Aceste informații pot fi utilizate pentru a evalua dacă conținutul solicitat poate fi descărcat, pentru a înțelege tendințele generale despre utilizarea dispozitivelor și stocare și dacă dispozitivul este conectat prin Wi‑Fi sau conexiune celulară. De exemplu, cunoașterea spațiului liber de pe dispozitiv a dat posibilitatea dezvoltării funcționalității care vă permite să cumpărați un film pe iPhone fără a‑l descărca la momentul achiziției. Dacă utilizați SharePlay pentru a viziona conținut împreună cu alți utilizatori, aplicația Apple TV va colecta informația că ați vizionat conținutul respectiv în timpul unei sesiuni SharePlay și numărul de dispozitive care au participat la sesiune, dar nu colectează nicio informație pentru a identifica participanții unei sesiuni SharePlay.

Utilizăm datele căutărilor legate de Apple TV pentru a îmbunătăți modelele care stau la baza Apple TV. De exemplu, interogările agregate ale căutărilor legate de Apple TV sunt utilizate pentru a perfecționa modelul de căutare în Apple TV.

Personalizarea aplicației Apple TV

Aplicația Apple TV este personalizată pentru a vă ajuta să descoperiți conținutul cel mai relevant pentru dvs. De exemplu, vă recomandăm filme despre care credem că v‑ar interesa pe baza celor pe care le‑ați vizionat anterior și vă oferim rezultate mai relevante ale căutărilor pe baza activității dvs. din aplicația Apple TV. Pentru a oferi personalizare, utilizăm informații care includ ceea ce vizionați, achizițiile, abonamentele, descărcările, căutările, istoricul de explorare și alte activități pe care le realizați în aplicația Apple TV, precum și informații din contul dvs., cum ar fi ce vârstă aveți.

Dacă nu doriți ca Apple să utilizeze informațiile despre ceea ce vizionați pe acest dispozitiv în aplicația Apple TV pentru personalizare pe toate dispozitivele compatibile cu aplicația Apple TV, puteți dezactiva funcționalitatea „Utilizare istoric de redare” în Configurări. Pe un dispozitiv iOS, iPadOS, visionOS sau tvOS, accesați Configurări > Aplicații > TV > Utilizare istoric de redare. În aplicația Apple TV de pe Mac, accesați TV > Configurări > Redare, apoi deselectați „Utilizați istoricul de vizionare”.

Puteți dezactiva funcționalitățile de personalizare din App Store, Apple Books, iTunes Store, Apple TV, Apple Podcasts și pentru abonamentele de la Apple prin dezactivarea recomandărilor personalizate pentru contul dvs. Apple. Pe un dispozitiv iOS, iPadOS sau visionOS, accesați Configurări > [numele dvs.] > Multimedia și achiziții > Afișați contul, apoi apăsați pentru a dezactiva „Recomandări personalizate”.

Comunicarea cu dvs.

Apple poate utiliza informații despre contul dvs., precum produsele Apple pe care le dețineți, abonamentele la servicii Apple, aplicațiile Apple pe care le descărcați și codul ZIP de facturare, pentru a vă trimite comunicări despre aplicația Apple TV și alte produse, servicii și oferte Apple care v‑ar putea interesa, inclusiv Apple One. Detalii despre dispozitivul dvs., precum numărul serial al acestuia sau detalii despre abonamentele dvs. App Store relevante pot fi utilizate pentru a verifica eligibilitatea dvs. pentru oferte Apple. Dacă faceți parte dintr‑un grup de Partajare familială, Apple vă poate trimite comunicări despre produsele, serviciile și ofertele disponibile pentru dvs. prin Partajare familială. Dacă achiziționați un abonament Apple One, este posibil să vă trimitem e‑mailuri și notificări despre funcționalitățile fiecăruia dintre serviciile la care v‑ați abonat. De asemenea, Apple poate utiliza informații despre activitatea dvs. în cadrul aplicației Apple TV pentru a vă trimite e‑mailuri și notificări despre noi funcționalități, conținut și oferte disponibile în aplicația Apple TV. Vă puteți schimba preferințele legate de e‑mail și puteți opta împotriva primirii acestor e‑mailuri accesând account.apple.com. Pentru a actualiza preferințele legate de notificări pe un dispozitiv iOS, iPadOS sau visionOS, accesați Configurări > Notificări > TV.

Publicitatea

În aplicația Apple TV, dacă acordați aplicației Apple TV permisiunea de a vă accesa localizarea, localizarea dvs. poate fi utilizată pentru a furniza reclame relevante din punct de vedere geografic.

Pentru alte aplicații, precum App Store, Apple News și Bursa, dacă opțiunea „Reclame personalizate” este activată, platforma publicitară Apple poate utiliza informațiile dvs., inclusiv informații despre filmele și emisiunile TV pe care le‑ați achiziționat de la Apple, pentru a vă furniza reclame în acele aplicații care sunt mai relevante pentru dvs.

Dacă nu doriți să recepționați reclame direcționate în funcție de interesele dvs. de la platforma publicitară Apple, puteți opta să dezactivați opțiunea „Reclame personalizate”. Dezactivarea opțiunii „Reclame personalizate” va împiedica Apple să utilizeze informațiile dvs. pentru direcționarea reclamelor. Este posibil ca numărul reclamelor recepționate să nu scadă, dar reclamele ar putea fi mai puțin relevante pentru dvs.

Puteți schimba configurările pentru Reclame personalizate accesând Configurări > Intimitate și securitate > Publicitate Apple.

Aflați mai multe despre publicitatea Apple și intimitate la www.apple.com/legal/privacy/data/ro/apple-advertising.

Aflați despre modul în care puteți opta împotriva reclamelor personalizate în App Store, Apple News și Bursa la adresa support.apple.com/105131.

Abonamente Apple TV prin parteneri

Dacă furnizorul dvs. de rețea mobilă oferă abonamente la Apple TV și perioade de încercare gratuită, Apple poate verifica numărul dvs. de telefon pentru a determina dacă sunteți eligibil(ă) prin intermediul unui furnizor de rețea mobilă partener. Dacă vă înscrieți pentru un abonament Apple TV sau pentru o perioadă de încercare gratuită prin intermediul furnizorului de rețea mobilă sau a altui partener Apple, Apple va utiliza numărul dvs. de telefon sau un identificator de cont unic partajat de partener pentru identificarea contului dvs. și pentru a aduce la cunoștința furnizorului de rețea mobilă sau a celuilalt partener faptul că v‑ați activat abonamentul. Numărul de telefon sau identificatorul unic asociat cu abonamentul va fi utilizat pentru verificarea contului dvs. la autentificare și pentru conectarea abonamentului dvs. Apple TV cu respectivul cont.

Dacă achiziționați un abonament Apple TV prin intermediul unui partener care vă dă posibilitatea de a viziona conținutul abonamentului Apple TV pe platforma sa, partenerul respectiv vă poate permite să vă conectați contul deschis la acesta și contul Apple pentru a putea viziona conținutul abonamentului Apple TV și în aplicația Apple TV. Când optați să vă conectați contul de la partener, Apple primește anumite informații despre contul dvs. de la respectivul partener, dar stochează doar starea abonamentului dvs. Apple TV alături de un ID de partener.

Partajarea cu terțe părți

Furnizăm unele date nepersonale publicitarilor și partenerilor strategici care colaborează cu Apple pentru furnizarea produselor și serviciilor noastre, care sprijină Apple în vederea distribuirii acestora către clienți și vând în numele Apple reclame de afișat în App Store, Apple News și Bursa. De exemplu, putem partaja date nepersonale despre tranzacțiile, activitatea de vizionare și regiunea dvs., precum și date demografice agregate despre utilizatori, cum ar fi grupa de vârstă și genul (care poate fi dedus din informații cum ar fi numele dvs. și formula de salut din contul Apple), cu partenerii strategici Apple TV, cum ar fi proprietarii de conținut, pentru a le da acestora posibilitatea să își măsoare performanțele lucrărilor de creație, să respecte cerințele legate de redevențe și contabilitate și să își îmbunătățească produsele și serviciile.

Dacă vă autentificați în aplicația Apple TV de pe un dispozitiv non‑Apple, Apple poate partaja informații cu furnizorul platformei respective pentru a permite funcționarea aplicației, astfel încât conținutul din abonamentele dvs. Apple TV să apară pe platformă, și pentru a susține funcționalități ale platformei, precum oferirea rezultatelor căutărilor și recomandărilor personalizate. Acestea pot include informații care denotă dacă ați deschis sau nu aplicația Apple TV și, după caz, dacă v‑ați abonat sau nu la Apple TV și canalele Apple TV. Puteți opta să opriți partajarea informațiilor despre abonamentul dvs. în configurările aplicației Apple TV de pe dispozitivul non‑Apple, însă acest lucru poate limita modalitățile în care conținutul Apple TV apare pe platforma respectivă.

Pe dispozitivele non‑Apple compatibile, puteți opta să partajați ceea ce vizionați, cumpărați sau închiriați în aplicația Apple TV, inclusiv abonamentul dvs. Apple TV, canalele Apple TV și celelalte tipuri de conținut (după caz), cu furnizorul platformei terțe pe care o utilizați. Sunt incluse aici numele profilului dvs. sau alte informații utilizate pentru a asocia datele din aplicația Apple TV cu contul sau profilul dvs. de pe dispozitivul non‑Apple. Furnizorul platformei poate utiliza informațiile dvs. din aplicația Apple TV pentru a face posibile funcționalități ale platformei, cum ar fi afișarea emisiunilor în curs de vizionare și recomandări personalizate. Puteți dezactiva această opțiune accesând configurările aplicației Apple TV de pe dispozitivul dvs. non‑Apple. Pe unele dispozitive, este posibilă redirecționarea dvs. la configurările platformei.

Dacă optați să vă autentificați în aplicația Apple TV de pe un dispozitiv non‑Apple, ar trebui să consultați clauzele, politicile de confidențialitate și practicile furnizorului platformei respective pentru a înțelege ce date colectează, utilizează și partajează acesta.

Retenția

Datele personale asociate cu achizițiile, descărcările și activitatea de vizionare din aplicația Apple TV sunt reținute pentru diferite perioade de timp, în funcție de necesitățile comerciale, obligațiile contractuale și cerințele legale. Pentru achiziții și descărcări, este adesea necesară o perioadă de retenție de minimum zece ani, dar, în regiuni precum China, perioada respectivă poate fi de 30 de ani. Reținem, de asemenea, o înregistrare a achizițiilor și descărcărilor dvs. de conținut cel puțin atât timp cât aveți un cont la noi pentru a vă permite să descărcați conținutul respectiv, în conformitate cu clauzele aplicabile. Reținem alte informații, precum activitatea de explorare și căutările, timp de până la doi ani. Unele informații, precum tranzacțiile, dar nu și detaliile stocate referitoare la cardurile de credit, pot fi reținute ca înregistrări comerciale chiar și după ce vă închideți contul sau încetați utilizarea aplicației Apple TV.

Când utilizați un card de plată, Apple poate reține și actualiza automat numărul cardului și informațiile de facturare pentru achiziții viitoare, tranzacții recurente sau alte utilizări autorizate de dvs. Apple poate obține aceste informații de la instituția dvs. financiară sau rețeaua de plată și le poate utiliza, de asemenea, pentru prevenirea fraudelor și verificare.

Degajarea istoricului de redare

Vă puteți degaja istoricul de redare din aplicația Apple TV în Configurări. În aplicația Apple TV de pe un dispozitiv iOS, iPadOS sau visionOS, accesați Cont > Degajați istoricul de redare. Pe tvOS, accesați Configurări > Aplicații > TV > Degajați istoricul de redare. Toate emisiunile TV și filmele vor fi eliminate din „Lista de vizionare”, iar orice istoric de redare va fi disociat de contul dvs. Acest lucru va fi valabil pentru datele dvs. de redare care sunt păstrate și utilizate de Apple pe dispozitivele care utilizează același cont Apple. Dacă utilizați un dispozitiv non‑Apple și ați optat să partajați ceea ce vizionați cu furnizorul platformei respective, degajarea istoricului de redare nu va afecta datele de redare care sunt stocate de furnizorul platformei. Este recomandat să analizați clauzele, politicile de confidențialitate și practicile furnizorului platformei pentru a înțelege dacă puteți șterge datele stocate de furnizorul respectiv.

Puteți elimina articole individuale din „Lista de vizionare” apăsând lung pe episod și selectând «Eliminați din „Lista de vizionare”». În același meniu, dacă selectați Eliminați din Vizionate recent, episodul va fi înlăturat, de asemenea, dintre cele utilizate pentru a genera recomandări personalizate. Cu toate acestea, Apple va reține înregistrări ale istoricului dvs. de redare din canalele Apple TV și abonamentul Apple TV pentru a respecta cerințe legate de raportare și redevențe.

Aplicații terțe conectate

Pentru a începe să partajați cu Apple ceea ce vizionați din aplicațiile terțe participante, trebuie să le acordați aplicațiilor respective permisiunea de a fi conectate la aplicația Apple TV. Atunci când configurați aplicația Apple TV, este posibil să vi se ceară să acordați permisiunea pentru mai multe aplicații simultan. Este posibil ca unele dintre aplicații să nu fie încă instalate pe acel dispozitiv, iar preferințele dvs. vor fi aplicate dacă sunt instalate ulterior. Indiferent dacă acordați permisiune sau nu, vă veți putea schimba preferințele pentru fiecare aplicație în Configurări.

În orice moment, dacă decideți că nu mai doriți ca una dintre aplicațiile terțe să fie conectată la aplicația Apple TV, puteți deconecta acea aplicație de la aplicația Apple TV, iar Apple va opri colectarea datelor dvs. de redare pentru aplicația terță respectivă. În aplicația Apple TV de pe un dispozitiv iOS, iPadOS sau visionOS, accesați Cont > Aplicații conectate, selectați aplicația terță și dezactivați‑o. Pe tvOS, accesați Configurări > Aplicații > TV > Conectare la TV, selectați aplicația terță și dezactivați‑o. Când eliminați o aplicație terță din aplicația Apple TV, puteți opta, de asemenea, pentru ștergerea tuturor datelor de redare pe care Apple le‑a colectat despre conținutul pe care l‑ați vizionat din aplicația respectivă alegând opțiunea Eliminați și degajați istoricul de redare. De asemenea, puteți opta oricând să ștergeți toate datele de redare pe care Apple le‑a colectat despre conținutul terț pe care l‑ați vizionat în aplicația Apple TV prin degajarea istoricului de redare, conform celor descrise mai sus. Degajarea istoricului de redare în oricare dintre circumstanțele descrise degajează doar datele de redare ale aplicației terțe care sunt păstrate și utilizate de Apple pentru aplicația Apple TV. Aceasta nu afectează datele de redare care sunt păstrate separat de furnizorul aplicației terțe (de exemplu, în cadrul propriei aplicații sau pe propriile servere).

Este recomandat să examinați termenele, politicile de confidențialitate și practicile aplicațiilor terțe participante pentru a înțelege modul în care acestea utilizează și partajează datele dvs. de redare și informațiile asociate.

Recomandări de grup

Dacă optați să activați funcționalitatea „Recomandări de grup” pe un dispozitiv Apple TV, informațiile despre ce vizionați vor fi utilizate pentru a realiza recomandări de grup cu orice combinație de utilizatori care au optat pentru funcționalitate pe același Apple TV. Dacă grupul include conturi pentru copii, vor fi incluse recomandări pentru copii, dar istoricul lor de vizionare nu va fi utilizat. Puteți dezactiva oricând recomandările de grup pentru contul dvs. accesând Configurări > Utilizatori și conturi, selectând profilul, apoi selectând „Pentru toți utilizatorii”.

Prevenirea fraudelor și a activităților rău intenționate

De asemenea, colectăm date personale pentru a preveni fraudele și alte activități răuvoitoare în aplicația Apple TV. Aceste date includ informații precum tipul dispozitivului și versiunea software, informații de localizare (dacă sunt disponibile, aproximate prin corelarea adresei IP a conexiunii dvs. la internet cu o regiune geografică), istoricul descărcărilor și achizițiilor, precum și alte interacțiuni cu aplicația Apple TV. Atunci când abonamentul dvs. este configurat pentru a se reînnoi automat, Apple poate utiliza și informații despre istoricul relației dvs. comerciale cu Apple pentru a procesa solicitarea și a determina dacă să furnizeze acces continuu la abonamentul dvs. înaintea autorizării de către partenerul de plată.

De asemenea, putem calcula un scor de încredere pentru dispozitivul dvs. atunci când încercați să realizați o achiziție, utilizând informații despre modul în care vă utilizați dispozitivul, inclusiv numărul aproximativ de apeluri telefonice sau de e‑mailuri pe care le trimiteți sau le primiți. Trimiterea este concepută în așa fel încât Apple să nu poată afla valorile subiacente de pe dispozitivul dvs. Scorul este stocat pentru o perioadă fixă de timp pe serverele noastre.

Temei juridic aplicabil pentru procesarea datelor personale

În general, procesăm datele dvs. personale în aplicația Apple TV pentru executarea contractului dvs. cu Apple, așa cum este necesar pentru furnizarea serviciului și în scopul respectării obligațiilor legale. În cazul în care consimțământul este temeiul legal corespunzător, îl solicităm conform legilor locale în vigoare.

În cazul în care legislația locală în vigoare prevede acest lucru, procesăm date personale, așa cum este necesar în scopul intereselor legitime ale noastre sau ale terților, pentru:

• Afișarea conținutului disponibil și relevant pentru dvs., inclusiv de la servicii terțe
• Verificarea eligibilității pentru oferte, îmbunătățirea și optimizarea serviciului pentru dvs. și pentru ceilalți utilizatori, precum și trimiterea de comunicări despre aplicația Apple TV și alte produse, servicii și oferte Apple care v‑ar putea interesa
• Prevenirea fraudelor și a activităților rău intenționate

Datele utilizate includ:

• Modul în care utilizați aplicația Apple TV, inclusiv funcționalitățile pe care le utilizați (de exemplu, „Continuați vizionarea” sau biblioteca), articolele pe care le‑ați căutat, interacțiunile dvs. cu notificările, paginile de conținut pe care le explorați sau vizualizați, conținutul pe care îl vizionați, achiziționați, descărcați și la care vă abonați, precum și informații despre erori sau blocări în aplicație
• Detalii despre dispozitivul și contul dvs.
• Scorul de încredere al dispozitivului
• Localizarea dvs.

Informațiile colectate de Apple vor fi în permanență tratate în conformitate cu politica de confidențialitate Apple, care se află la www.apple.com/ro/privacy.

The Apple TV app allows you to watch your favorite TV shows and movies all in one place. You can watch content you have rented or purchased from Apple. If available, you can also access content through your Apple TV subscription, Apple TV channels, and your connected third-party video apps. You can access all of this content through the Apple TV app across supported devices that are signed in to the same Apple Account.

Providing the Apple TV App

We use your personal data to provide the services and features in the Apple TV app. This information includes your account and payment information, which you can access and change in Settings.

Apple collects information about what you purchase and what you’re watching in the Apple TV app on any supported devices signed in to the same Apple Account. Apple stores this information associated with your Apple Account so we can display what you’re watching across your supported devices. When you sign in to third-party apps, information about whether you have subscribed to those services is used to display content available to you. If you grant permission for a third-party app to be connected to the Apple TV app, Apple will collect and store information about what you watch from that app on any of your supported devices, as well as your subscription status. Apple apps with supported content, such as Apple Music and Remote, will be automatically connected when you start using the Apple TV app.

Information about what you’re watching will include what content you’re playing, when you played it, the device you played it from, and where in the content you paused or stopped watching. We also collect a detailed history of all playback activity for Apple TV channels and your Apple TV subscription.

If you allow the Apple TV app to access your location, your location will be used to determine what’s available in your region, including local content like live games, events, and news. Some content includes geographically relevant ads.

Improving the Apple TV App

Apple collects information about your usage of the Apple TV app and your account, including the features you use (for example, Continue Watching or Library), items you search for, your interactions with notifications, content pages you browse or view, information on errors or crashes within the app, and your billing zip code. We use this information, approximate location information that does not identify you, and information about what you watch to help improve and optimize the service for you and others. We also collect information about your device such as the type of device, the channel through which your device was obtained, the version of your operating system, and the amount of free space on your device. We may use this information to assess whether requested content can be downloaded, to understand general trends in device usage and storage, and whether your device is connected by Wi-Fi or cellular. For example, knowing the free space on your device allowed us to build the feature that lets you buy a movie on your iPhone without downloading it at purchase. If you use SharePlay to watch content with other users, the Apple TV app will collect that you watched that content during a SharePlay session and the number of devices that participated in the session, but does not collect any information to identify the participants of a SharePlay session.

We use Apple TV search data to improve models that power Apple TV. For example, aggregate Apple TV search queries are used to fine-tune the Apple TV search model.

Personalizing the Apple TV App

We personalize the Apple TV app to help you discover the content that’s most relevant to you. For example, we recommend movies that we think will be of interest to you based on movies you’ve previously watched, and we provide more relevant search results to you based on your activity in the Apple TV app. To provide personalization, we use information including what you watch, your purchases, subscriptions, downloads, searches, browsing, and other activities in the Apple TV app, as well as information from your account such as your age.

If you do not want Apple to use information about what you watch on this device in the Apple TV app for personalization on all devices that support the Apple TV app, you can turn off Use Play History in Settings. On your iOS, iPadOS, visionOS, or tvOS device, go to Settings > Apps > TV > Use Play History. In the Apple TV app on Mac, go to TV > Settings > Playback, then deselect Use Viewing History.

You can turn off personalization features in the App Store, Apple Books, the iTunes Store, Apple TV, Apple Podcasts, and for subscriptions from Apple by turning off Personalized Recommendations for your Apple Account. On your iOS, iPadOS, or visionOS device, go to Settings > [your name] > Media & Purchases > View Account, then tap to turn off Personalized Recommendations.

Communicating with You

Apple may use information about your account, such as the Apple products you own, your subscriptions to Apple services, the Apple apps you download, and your billing zip code, to send you communications about the Apple TV app and other Apple products, services, and offers that may be of interest to you, including Apple One. Details about your device, such as its device serial number, or details about your relevant App Store subscriptions may be used to check eligibility for Apple offers. If you are in a Family Sharing group, Apple may send you communications about products, services, and offers available to you through Family Sharing. If you purchase an Apple One subscription, we may send you emails and notifications about the features of each of the services for which you have subscribed. Apple may also use information about your activity within the Apple TV app to send you emails and notifications about new features, content, and offers available in the Apple TV app. You can change your email preferences and opt out of receiving these emails by going to account.apple.com. To update notification preferences on your iOS, iPadOS, or visionOS device, go to Settings > Notifications > TV.

Advertising

In the Apple TV app, if you allow the Apple TV app to access your location, your location may be used to serve geographically relevant ads.

For other apps such as the App Store, Apple News, and Stocks, if the Personalized Ads setting is turned on, Apple’s advertising platform may use your information, including information about the movies and TV shows you purchase from Apple, to serve ads in those apps that are more relevant to you.

If you do not want to receive ads targeted to your interests from Apple’s advertising platform, you can choose to turn off Personalized Ads. Turning off Personalized Ads will prevent Apple from using your information for ad targeting. It may not decrease the number of ads you receive, but the ads may be less relevant to you.

You can change your Personalized Ads settings by going to Settings > Privacy & Security > Apple Advertising.

Learn more about Apple Advertising & Privacy at www.apple.com/legal/privacy/data/en/apple-advertising.

Learn about how to opt out of personalized ads on the App Store, Apple News, and Stocks at support.apple.com/105131.

Apple TV Subscriptions Through Partners

If your mobile network provider offers Apple TV subscriptions and free trials, Apple may check your phone number to determine whether you are eligible through a mobile network provider partner. If you sign up for an Apple TV subscription or free trial through your mobile network provider or another Apple partner, Apple will use your phone number or a unique account identifier shared by the partner to identify your account and to let the mobile network provider or other partner know that you have activated your subscription. We will use the phone number or unique identifier associated with your subscription to verify your account at sign in and to connect your Apple TV subscription with your account.

If you purchase an Apple TV subscription through a partner that enables you to watch Apple TV subscription content on their platform, the partner may allow you to connect your partner account and your Apple Account so that you can also view Apple TV subscription content in the Apple TV app. When you choose to connect your partner account, Apple receives certain information about your account with partner, but Apple stores only your Apple TV subscription status along with a partner ID.

Sharing with Third Parties

We provide some non-personal data to our advertisers and strategic partners that work with Apple to provide our products and services, help Apple market to customers, and sell ads on Apple’s behalf to display on the App Store and Apple News and Stocks. For example, we may share non-personal data about your transactions, viewing activity, and region, as well as aggregated user demographics such as age group and gender (which may be inferred from information such as your name and salutation in your Apple Account), to Apple TV strategic partners, such as content owners, so that they can measure the performance of their creative work, meet royalty and accounting requirements, and improve their associated products and services.

If you sign in to the Apple TV app on a non-Apple device, Apple may share information with the platform provider to enable the app to function, so that content from your Apple TV subscriptions appears on the platform, and to support platform features such as providing search results and personalized recommendations. This may include information about whether you have opened the Apple TV app and, where available, whether you have subscribed to Apple TV and Apple TV channels. You can choose to stop sharing your subscription information in the Apple TV app settings on your non-Apple device, although doing so may limit the ways that Apple TV content appears on the platform.

On supported non-Apple devices, you can choose whether to share what you watch, buy, or rent in the Apple TV app, including your Apple TV subscription, Apple TV channels, and other content (where available) with the provider of your third-party platform. This may include your profile name or other information used to match your data from the Apple TV app with your account or profile on your non-Apple device. Your platform provider may use your information from the Apple TV app to enable platform features such as displaying the shows you have in progress and personalized recommendations. You can turn this off by going to the Apple TV app settings on your non-Apple device. On some devices, this may direct you to the platform’s settings.

If you choose to sign in to the Apple TV app on a non-Apple device, you should review the terms, privacy policies, and practices of the platform’s provider to understand what data it collects, uses, and shares.

Retention

We retain personal data associated with your purchases, downloads, and viewing activity on the Apple TV app for different lengths of time depending on business need, contractual obligations, and legal requirements. For purchases and downloads, that often requires at least a 10-year retention period, but in regions such as China that period can be 30 years. We also retain a record of your purchase and downloads of content for at least as long as you have an account with us to allow you to download that content in line with our applicable terms. We retain other information such as browsing activity and searches for up to two years. Some information, such as transactions but not your stored card details may be retained as business records even after you close your account or stop using the Apple TV app.

When you use a payment card, Apple may retain and automatically update your card number and billing information for future purchases, recurring transactions, or other uses you authorize. Apple may obtain this information from your financial institution or payment network, and also use it for fraud prevention and verification.

Clear Play History

You can clear your play history in the Apple TV app in Settings. In the Apple TV app on your iOS, iPadOS, or visionOS device, go to Account > Clear Play History. On tvOS, go to Settings > Apps > TV > Clear Play History. This will remove all TV shows and movies from your Watchlist and disassociate any past playback history from your account. This will apply to your play data that is held and used by Apple on devices that use the same Apple Account. If you use a non-Apple device and have chosen to share what you watch with that platform’s provider, clearing your play history will not affect the play data that is stored by the platform’s provider. You should review the terms, privacy policies, and practices of the platform’s provider to understand whether you can delete the data stored by that provider.

You can remove individual items from your Watchlist by long-pressing the episode and selecting Remove from Watchlist. In the same menu, if you select Remove from Recently Watched, that will also remove the episode from being used to generate personalized recommendations. However, Apple will retain records of play history from Apple TV channels and your Apple TV subscription for reporting and royalty requirements.

Third-Party Connected Apps

You must grant permission for your participating third-party apps to be connected to the Apple TV app to begin sharing what you watch from those apps with Apple. When you set up the Apple TV app, you may be asked to grant permission for multiple applications at one time. Some of the apps may be apps that you do not yet have installed on that device, and your preferences will be applied if they are installed later. Whether or not you grant permission, you will be able to change your preferences for each app in Settings.

If at any time you decide you no longer want one of your third-party apps to be connected to the Apple TV app, you may disconnect that app from the Apple TV app and Apple will stop collecting your play data from that third-party app. In the Apple TV app on your iOS, iPadOS, or visionOS device, go to Account > Connected Apps, select the third-party app and turn it off. On tvOS, go to Settings > Apps > TV > Connect to TV, select the third-party app and turn it off. When removing a third-party app from the Apple TV app, you may also choose to delete all play data information Apple has collected about content you’ve watched from that app by choosing the Remove and Clear Play History option. At any time, you may also choose to delete all of your play data information Apple has collected about all third-party content you watch in the Apple TV app by clearing your play history as described above. Clearing your play history in any of these described instances only clears your third-party app play data that is held and used by Apple for the Apple TV app. It does not affect any play data that is held separately by the third-party app provider (for example, within their own app or on their servers).

You should also review the terms, privacy policies, and practices of your participating third-party apps to understand how they use and share your play data and related information.

Group Recommendations

If you choose to enable Group Recommendations on an Apple TV device, information about what you watch will be used to make group recommendations with any combination of opted-in users on the same Apple TV. If a child account is in the group, recommendations for children will be included, but their watch history will not be used. You can turn off Group Recommendations for your account at any time by going to Settings > Users and Accounts, selecting your profile, then selecting For All of You.

Preventing Fraud and Other Malicious Activity

We also collect personal data to prevent fraud and other malicious activity in the Apple TV app. This information includes device information, such as device type and software version, location information (approximated by matching the IP address of your internet connection to a geographic region, if available), download and purchase history, and other interactions with the Apple TV app. When your subscription is set to auto-renew, Apple may also use information about your historical business relationship with Apple to process the request and determine whether to provide ongoing access to your subscription in advance of authorization by the payment partner.

We also may compute a device trust score on your device when you attempt a purchase, using information about how you use your device, including the approximate number of phone calls or emails you send and receive. The submission is designed so Apple cannot learn the underlying values on your device. The score is stored for a fixed time on our servers.

Applicable Legal Basis for Processing Personal Data

We process your personal data in the Apple TV app generally for performance of your contract with Apple, as necessary for providing the service, and to comply with our legal obligations. Where consent is the appropriate legal basis, we seek it in accordance with applicable local law.

Where applicable local law provides, we process personal data as necessary for purposes of our legitimate interests or those of a third party in order to:

• Display available and relevant content to you, including from third-party services
• Check eligibility for offers, help to improve and optimize the service for you and others, and send you communications about the Apple TV app and other Apple products, services, and offers that may be of interest to you
• Prevent fraud and other malicious activity

The data used includes:

• Your use of the Apple TV app including features you use (for example, Continue Watching or Library), items you search for, your interactions with notifications, content pages you browse or view, what you watch, purchase, subscribe to, and download, and information about errors or crashes within the app
• Details about your device and account
• The device trust score

ਜੇਕਰ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਚਾਹੁੰਦੇ ਕਿ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਜੋ ਕੁਝ ਇਸ ਡਿਵਾਈਸ ’ਤੇ Apple TV ਐਪ ਵਿੱਚ ਦੇਖਦੇ ਹੋ, ਉਸ ਸੰਬੰਧੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ Apple TV ਐਪ ਸਮਰਥਿਤ ਸਭ ਡਿਵਾਈਸਾਂ ’ਤੇ ਵਿਅਕਤੀਗਤ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਾਵੇ, ਤਾਂ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਸੈਟਿੰਗਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ “ਚਲਾਉਣ ਦੀ ਹਿਸਟਰੀ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕਰੋ” ਨੂੰ ਬੰਦ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ। ਆਪਣੇ iOS, iPadOS, visionOS ਜਾਂ tvOS ਡਿਵਾਈਸ ’ਤੇ ਸੈਟਿੰਗਾਂ > ਐਪਾਂ > TV > ਚਲਾਉਣ ਦੀ ਹਿਸਟਰੀ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕਰੋ ’ਤੇ ਜਾਓ। Mac ’ਤੇ Apple TV ਐਪ ਵਿੱਚ, TV > ਸੈਟਿੰਗਾਂ > ਪਲੇਬੈਕ ’ਤੇ ਜਾਓ, ਫਿਰ “ਦੇਖਣ ਦੀ ਹਿਸਟਰੀ ਵਰਤੋ” ਨੂੰ ਅਣਚੁਣਿਆ ਕਰੋ।

ਭਾਈਵਾਲਾਂ ਰਾਹੀਂ Apple TV ਸਬਸਕ੍ਰਿਪਸ਼ਨ

ਜੇ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਮੋਬਾਈਲ ਨੈੱਟਵਰਕ ਪ੍ਰਦਾਤਾ ਵੱਲੋਂ Apple TV ਸਬਸਕ੍ਰਿਪਸ਼ਨਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਮੁਫ਼ਤ ਟ੍ਰਾਇਲ ਦੀ ਪੇਸ਼ਕਸ਼ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ, ਤਾਂ Apple ਇਹ ਜਾਣਨ ਲਈ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਮੋਬਾਈਲ ਨੰਬਰ ਦੀ ਜਾਂਚ ਕਰ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਮੋਬਾਈਲ ਨੈੱਟਵਰਕ ਪ੍ਰਦਾਤਾ ਭਾਈਵਾਲ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਇਸਦੇ ਯੋਗ ਹੋ ਜਾਂ ਨਹੀਂ। ਜੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਮੋਬਾਈਲ ਨੈੱਟਵਰਕ ਪ੍ਰਦਾਤਾ ਜਾਂ ਕਿਸੇ ਹੋਰ Apple ਭਾਈਵਾਲ ਰਾਹੀਂ Apple TV ਸਬਸਕ੍ਰਿਪਸ਼ਨ ਜਾਂ ਮੁਫ਼ਤ ਟ੍ਰਾਇਲ ਦੀ ਪੇਸ਼ਕਸ਼ ਲਈ ਸਾਈਨ ਅੱਪ ਕਰਦੇ ਹੋ, ਤਾਂ Apple ਵੱਲੋਂ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਫ਼ੋਨ ਨੰਬਰ ਜਾਂ ਭਾਈਵਾਲ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਸਾਂਝੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਗਏ ਵਿਲੱਖਣ ਖਾਤਾ ਪਛਾਣਕਰਤਾ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਖਾਤੇ ਦੀ ਪਛਾਣ ਕਰਨ ਅਤੇ ਮੋਬਾਈਲ ਨੈੱਟਵਰਕ ਪ੍ਰਦਾਤਾ ਜਾਂ ਹੋਰ ਭਾਈਵਾਲ ਨੂੰ ਇਹ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਦੇਣ ਲਈ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਆਪਣੀ ਸਬਸਕ੍ਰਿਪਸ਼ਨ ਕਿਰਿਆਸ਼ੀਲ ਕਰ ਲਈ ਹੈ। ਅਸੀਂ ਤੁਹਾਡੀ ਸਬਸਕ੍ਰਿਪਸ਼ਨ ਨਾਲ ਸੰਬੰਧਿਤ ਫ਼ੋਨ ਨੰਬਰ ਜਾਂ ਵਿਲੱਖਣ ਪਛਾਣਕਰਤਾ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਸਾਈਨ ਇਨ ਦੌਰਾਨ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਖਾਤੇ ਦੀ ਤਸਦੀਕ ਕਰਨ ਅਤੇ ਤੁਹਾਡੀ Apple TV ਸਬਸਕ੍ਰਿਪਸ਼ਨ ਨੂੰ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਖਾਤੇ ਨਾਲ ਕਨੈਕਟ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਕਰਾਂਗੇ।

ਜੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਕਿਸੇ ਅਜਿਹੇ ਭਾਈਵਾਲ ਰਾਹੀਂ Apple TV ਦੀ ਸਬਸਕ੍ਰਿਪਸ਼ਨ ਖ਼ਰੀਦਦੇ ਹੋ ਜੋ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਪਲੇਟਫ਼ਾਰਮ ’ਤੇ TV ਸਬਸਕ੍ਰਿਪਸ਼ਨ ਕੰਟੈਂਟ ਦਿਖਾ ਸਕੇ, ਤਾਂ ਭਾਈਵਾਲ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੇ ਭਾਈਵਾਲ ਖਾਤੇ ਅਤੇ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ Apple ਖਾਤੇ ਨੂੰ ਕਨੈਕਟ ਕਰਨ ਦੀ ਇਜਾਜ਼ਤ ਦਿੱਤੀ ਜਾ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਜੋ ਤੁਸੀਂ Apple TV ਐਪ ਵਿੱਚ Apple TV ਸਬਸਕ੍ਰਿਪਸ਼ਨ ਕੰਟੈਂਟ ਨੂੰ ਵੀ ਦੇਖ ਸਕੋ। ਜਦੋਂ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਆਪਣੇ ਭਾਈਵਾਲ ਖਾਤੇ ਨੂੰ ਕਨੈਕਟ ਕਰਨ ਦੀ ਚੋਣ ਕਰਦੇ ਹੋ, ਤਾਂ Apple ਨੂੰ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਭਾਈਵਾਲ ਦੇ ਖਾਤੇ ਬਾਰੇ ਕੁਝ ਖ਼ਾਸ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ ਪਰ Apple ਵੱਲੋਂ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਤੁਹਾਡੀ Apple TV ਸਬਸਕ੍ਰਿਪਸ਼ਨ ਦੀ ਸਥਿਤੀ ਨੂੰ ਭਾਈਵਾਲ ID ਸਮੇਤ ਸਟੋਰ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ।

ਤੀਜੀਆਂ ਧਿਰਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਸਾਂਝਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ

ਅਸੀਂ ਕੁਝ ਗ਼ੈਰ-ਨਿੱਜੀ ਡੇਟਾ ਆਪਣੇ ਵਿਗਿਆਪਨ ਦੇਣ ਵਾਲਿਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਖ਼ਾਸ ਹਿੱਸੇਦਾਰਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਦਾਨ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਾਂ ਜੋ ਸਾਡੇ ਉਤਪਾਦ ਅਤੇ ਸੇਵਾਵਾਂ ਪ੍ਰਦਾਨ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ Apple ਨਾਲ ਮਿਲ ਕੇ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ ਜਾਂ ਜੋ ਗਾਹਕਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ Apple ਦੀ ਮਾਰਕਿਟਿੰਗ ਕਰਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਮਦਦ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ ਅਤੇ App Store, Apple News ਅਤੇ ਸਟੌਕਸ ’ਤੇ ਦਿਖਾਉਣ ਲਈ Apple ਦੇ ਲਈ ਵਿਗਿਆਪਨ ਵੇਚਦੇ ਹਨ। ਉਦਾਹਰਨ ਲਈ, ਅਸੀਂ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਲੈਣ-ਦੇਣ, ਦੇਖਣ ਦੀ ਗਤੀਵਿਧੀ ਅਤੇ ਖੇਤਰ ਸੰਬੰਧੀ ਗੈਰ-ਨਿੱਜੀ ਡੇਟਾ ਸਾਂਝਾ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੇ ਹਾਂ, ਇਸ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਹੀ ਵਰਤੋਂਕਾਰ ਆਬਾਦੀ ਸੰਬੰਧੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਜਿਵੇਂ ਕਿ ਉਮਰ ਵਰਗ ਅਤੇ ਲਿੰਗ (ਜਿਸਦਾ ਅਨੁਮਾਨ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ Apple ਖਾਤੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਨਾਮ ਅਤੇ ਸੁਆਗਤੀ ਸ਼ਬਦਾਂ ਵਰਗੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਤੋਂ ਲਗਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ) ਨੂੰ Apple TV ਦੇ ਮਹੱਤਵਪੂਰਨ ਭਾਈਵਾਲਾਂ ਜਿਵੇਂ ਕਿ ਕੰਟੈਂਟ ਮਾਲਕਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਸਾਂਝਾ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੇ ਹਾਂ ਤਾਂ ਜੋ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਆਪਣੇ ਰਚਨਾਤਮਕ ਕਾਰਜਾਂ ਦੀ ਕਾਰਗੁਜ਼ਾਰੀ ਨੂੰ ਮਾਪਿਆ ਜਾ ਸਕੇ, ਰਾਇਲਟੀ ਤੇ ਲੇਖੇ ਜੋਖੇ ਦੀਆਂ ਲੋੜਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਪੂਰਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾ ਸਕੇ ਅਤੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਸੰਬੰਧਿਤ ਉਤਪਾਦਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਸੇਵਾਵਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਸੁਧਾਰ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾ ਸਕੇ।

ਜੇਕਰ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਕਿਸੇ ਗੈਰ-Apple ਡਿਵਾਈਸ ਤੋਂ Apple TV ਐਪ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਾਈਨ ਇਨ ਕਰਦੇ ਹੋ, ਤਾਂ ਐਪ ਨੂੰ ਚਲਾਉਣ ਦੇ ਸਮਰੱਥ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਲਈ Apple ਵੱਲੋਂ ਪਲੇਟਫ਼ਾਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਲ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਸਾਂਝੀ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਾ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਜੋ ਤੁਹਾਡੀ Apple TV ਸਬਸਕ੍ਰਿਪਸ਼ਨ ਦਾ ਕੰਟੈਂਟ ਉਸ ਪਲੇਟਫ਼ਾਰਮ ’ਤੇ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਸਕੇ ਅਤੇ ਖੋਜ ਨਤੀਜੇ ਤੇ ਵਿਅਕਤੀਗਤ ਸਿਫ਼ਾਰਸ਼ਾਂ ਆਦਿ ਪਲੇਟਫ਼ਾਰਮ ਫ਼ੀਚਰਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਮਰਥਨ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਜਾ ਸਕੇ। ਇਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਵੱਲੋਂ Apple TV ਐਪ ਨੂੰ ਖੋਲ੍ਹਣ ਜਾਂ ਨਾ ਖੋਲ੍ਹਣ ਅਤੇ ਜੇ ਉਪਲਬਧ ਹੋਵੇ ਤਾਂ, Apple TV ਤੇ Apple TV ਚੈਨਲਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਬਸਕ੍ਰਾਈਬ ਕਰਨ ਸੰਬੰਧੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਹੋ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ। ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਗੈਰ-Apple ਡਿਵਾਈਸ ‘ਤੇ Apple TV ਐਪ ਸੈਟਿੰਗਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਆਪਣੀ ਸਬਸਕ੍ਰਿਪਸ਼ਨ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਸਾਂਝੀ ਕਰਨਾ ਬੰਦ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ, ਹਾਲਾਂਕਿ ਅਜਿਹਾ ਕਰਨ ਨਾਲ ਪਲੇਟਫ਼ਾਰਮ ‘ਤੇ Apple TV ਕੰਟੈਂਟ ਦਿਖਾਉਣ ਦੇ ਤਰੀਕੇ ਸੀਮਤ ਹੋ ਸਕਦੇ ਹਨ।

ਸਮਰਥਿਤ ਗ਼ੈਰ-Apple ਡਿਵਾਈਸਾਂ ’ਤੇ, ਤੁਸੀਂ ਇਹ ਚੁਣ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ ਕਿ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਆਪਣੀ Apple TV ਸਬਸਕ੍ਰਿਪਸ਼ਨ, Apple TV ਚੈਨਲਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਹੋਰ ਕੰਟੈਂਟ (ਜੇ ਉਪਲਬਧ ਹੋਵੇ) ਸਮੇਤ Apple TV ਐਪ ਵਿੱਚ ਦੇਖੇ, ਖ਼ਰੀਦੇ ਜਾਂ ਕਿਰਾਏ ’ਤੇ ਲਏ ਕੰਟੈਂਟ ਨੂੰ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਤੀਜੀ-ਧਿਰ ਦੇ ਪਲੇਟਫ਼ਾਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਲ ਸਾਂਝਾ ਕਰਨਾ ਹੈ ਜਾਂ ਨਹੀਂ। ਇਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਪ੍ਰੋਫ਼ਾਈਲ ਨਾਮ ਜਾਂ Apple TV ਐਪ ਤੋਂ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਡੇਟਾ ਨੂੰ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਗ਼ੈਰ-Apple ਡਿਵਾਈਸ ’ਤੇ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਖਾਤੇ ਜਾਂ ਪ੍ਰੋਫ਼ਾਈਲ ਨਾਲ ਮੇਲ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਵਰਤੀ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੋਰ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਹੋ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ। ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਪਲੇਟਫ਼ਾਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਦਾਤਾ Apple TV ਐਪ ਤੋਂ ਤੁਹਾਡੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਦੇਖੇ ਜਾ ਰਹੇ ਸ਼ੋਅ ਅਤੇ ਵਿਅਕਤੀਗਤ ਸਿਫ਼ਾਰਸ਼ਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਦਿਖਾਉਣ ਵਰਗੇ ਪਲੇਟਫ਼ਾਰਮ ਫ਼ੀਚਰ ਸਮਰੱਥ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਕਰ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ। ਤੁਸੀਂ ਆਪਣੇ ਗੈਰ-Apple ਡਿਵਾਈਸ ’ਤੇ Apple TV ਐਪ ਸੈਟਿੰਗਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਇਸ ਨੂੰ ਬੰਦ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ। ਕੁਝ ਡਿਵਾਈਸਾਂ ’ਤੇ, ਇਸ ਨਾਲ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਪਲੇਟਫ਼ਾਰਮ ਦੀਆਂ ਸੈਟਿੰਗਾਂ ’ਤੇ ਭੇਜਿਆ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ।

ਜੇਕਰ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਗੈਰ-Apple ਡਿਵਾਈਸ ‘ਤੇ Apple TV ਐਪ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਾਈਨ ਇਨ ਕਰਨ ਦੀ ਚੋਣ ਕਰਦੇ ਹੋ, ਤਾਂ ਪਲੇਟਫ਼ਾਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਦਾਤਾ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਕਿਹੜਾ ਡੇਟਾ ਇਕੱਠਾ ਕੀਤਾ, ਵਰਤਿਆ ਅਤੇ ਸਾਂਝਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ, ਇਹ ਸਮਝਣ ਲਈ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਉਸ ਪ੍ਰਦਾਤਾ ਦੀਆਂ ਸ਼ਰਤਾਂ, ਪਰਦੇਦਾਰੀ ਨੀਤੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਅਮਲ ਦੀ ਸਮੀਖਿਆ ਕਰਨੀ ਚਾਹੀਦੀ ਹੈ।

ਡੇਟਾ ਸਾਂਭ ਕੇ ਰੱਖਣਾ

ਅਸੀਂ ਵਪਾਰਕ ਲੋੜਾਂ, ਇਕਰਾਰਨਾਮੇ ਸੰਬੰਧੀ ਵਚਨਬੱਧਤਾ ਅਤੇ ਕਾਨੂੰਨੀ ਲੋੜਾਂ ਦੇ ਆਧਾਰ ’ਤੇ ਵੱਖ-ਵੱਖ ਸਮੇਂ ਲਈ Apple TV ਐਪ ’ਤੇ ਤੁਹਾਡੀ ਖ਼ਰੀਦ, ਡਾਊਨਲੋਡ ਅਤੇ ਦੇਖਣ ਦੀ ਗਤੀਵਿਧੀ ਨਾਲ ਸੰਬੰਧਿਤ ਨਿੱਜੀ ਡੇਟਾ ਨੂੰ ਸਾਂਭ ਕੇ ਰੱਖਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ। ਖ਼ਰੀਦਦਾਰੀ ਅਤੇ ਡਾਊਨਲੋਡ ਲਈ ਅਕਸਰ ਘੱਟੋ ਘੱਟ ^[10](formatNumber: true) ਸਾਲ ਦੀ ਬੰਧੇਜ ਮਿਆਦ ਲੋੜੀਂਦੀ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ ਪਰ ਚੀਨ ਵਰਗੇ ਖੇਤਰਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਇਹ ਮਿਆਦ ^[30](formatNumber: true) ਸਾਲ ਹੋ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ। ਅਸੀਂ ਤੁਹਾਡੀ ਖ਼ਰੀਦਦਾਰੀ ਅਤੇ ਕੰਟੈਂਟ ਡਾਊਨਲੋਡ ਕਰਨ ਦਾ ਰਿਕਾਰਡ ਵੀ ਉਸ ਸਮੇਂ ਤੱਕ ਬਰਕਰਾਰ ਰੱਖਦੇ ਹਾਂ, ਜਦੋਂ ਤੱਕ ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਖਾਤਾ ਸਾਡੇ ਕੋਲ ਖੁੱਲਾ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਜੋ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਸਾਡੀਆਂ ਲਾਗੂ ਸ਼ਰਤਾਂ ਦੇ ਆਧਾਰ ’ਤੇ ਉਸ ਕੰਟੈਂਟ ਨੂੰ ਡਾਊਨਲੋਡ ਕਰਨ ਦੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਿਲ ਸਕੇ। ਅਸੀਂ ਬ੍ਰਾਊਜ਼ਿੰਗ ਗਤੀਵਿਧੀ ਅਤੇ ਖੋਜਾਂ ਵਰਗੀ ਹੋਰ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਨੂੰ ਦੋ ਸਾਲਾਂ ਤੱਕ ਸਾਂਭ ਕੇ ਰੱਖਦੇ ਹਾਂ। ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਖਾਤਾ ਬੰਦ ਕਰਨ ਜਾਂ Apple TV ਐਪ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਬੰਦ ਕਰਨ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਵੀ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਕਾਰਡ ਦੇ ਸਟੋਰ ਕੀਤੇ ਵੇਰਵਿਆਂ ਤੋਂ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਲੈਣ-ਦੇਣ ਵਰਗੀ ਕੁਝ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਨੂੰ ਵਿੱਤੀ ਰਿਕਾਰਡ ਵਜੋਂ ਸਾਂਭ ਕੇ ਰੱਖਿਆ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ।

ਜਦੋਂ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਕਿਸੇ ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਕਾਰਡ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕਰਦੇ ਹੋ, ਤਾਂ Apple ਭਵਿੱਖ ਵਿੱਚ ਖ਼ਰੀਦਾਂ, ਆਵਰਤੀ ਲੈਣ-ਦੇਣ ਜਾਂ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਹੋਰ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਦੇ ਲਈ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਕਾਰਡ ਨੰਬਰ ਅਤੇ ਬਿਲਿੰਗ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਨੂੰ ਬਰਕਰਾਰ ਰੱਖ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਆਟੋਮੈਟਿਕਲੀ ਅੱਪਡੇਟ ਕਰ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ। Apple ਇਹ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਨੂੰ ਤੁਹਾਡੀ ਵਿੱਤੀ ਸੰਸਥਾ ਜਾਂ ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਨੈੱਟਵਰਕ ਤੋਂ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤ ਕਰ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਧੋਖਾਧੜੀ ਨੂੰ ਰੋਕਣ ਅਤੇ ਤਸਦੀਕੀਕਰਨ ਦੇ ਲਈ ਇਸ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਵੀ ਕਰ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ।

ਚਲਾਉਣ ਦੀ ਹਿਸਟਰੀ ਸਾਫ਼ ਕਰੋ

ਤੁਸੀਂ ਸੈਟਿੰਗਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ Apple TV ਐਪ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਆਪਣੀ ਚਲਾਉਣ ਦੀ ਹਿਸਟਰੀ ਨੂੰ ਸਾਫ਼ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ। ਆਪਣੇ iOS, iPadOS ਜਾਂ visionOS ਡਿਵਾਈਸ ’ਤੇ Apple TV ਐਪ ਵਿੱਚ, ਖਾਤਾ > ਚਲਾਉਣ ਦੀ ਹਿਸਟਰੀ ਸਾਫ਼ ਕਰੋ ’ਤੇ ਜਾਓ। tvOS ’ਤੇ, ਸੈਟਿੰਗਾਂ > ਐਪਾਂ > TV > ਚਲਾਉਣ ਦੀ ਹਿਸਟਰੀ ਸਾਫ਼ ਕਰੋ ’ਤੇ ਜਾਓ। ਇਸ ਨਾਲ ਤੁਹਾਡੀ ਵਾਚਲਿਸਟ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਸਾਰੇ TV ਸ਼ੋਅ ਅਤੇ ਮੂਵੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਹਟਾ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਜਾਵੇਗਾ ਅਤੇ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਖਾਤੇ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕਿਸੇ ਵੀ ਪੁਰਾਣੀ ਪਲੇਬੈਕ ਹਿਸਟਰੀ ਨੂੰ ਮਿਟਾ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਜਾਵੇਗਾ। ਇਹ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਚਲਾਉਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਡੇਟਾ ’ਤੇ ਲਾਗੂ ਹੋਵੇਗਾ ਜੋ Apple ਵੱਲੋਂ ਇੱਕੋ ਹੀ Apple ਖਾਤੇ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਡਿਵਾਈਸਾਂ ’ਤੇ ਰੱਖਿਆ ਅਤੇ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ। ਜੇਕਰ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਗੈਰ-Apple ਡਿਵਾਈਸ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕਰਦੇ ਹੋ ਅਤੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਜੋ ਕੰਟੈਂਟ ਦੇਖਦੇ ਹੋ, ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਪਲੇਟਫ਼ਾਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਲ ਸਾਂਝਾ ਕਰਨ ਦੀ ਚੋਣ ਕੀਤੀ ਹੈ, ਤਾਂ ਤੁਹਾਡੀ ਚਲਾਉਣ ਦੀ ਹਿਸਟਰੀ ਨੂੰ ਸਾਫ਼ ਕਰਨ ਦਾ ਪਲੇਟਫ਼ਾਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਦਾਤਾ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਸਟੋਰ ਕੀਤੇ ਚਲਾਉਣ ਸੰਬੰਧੀ ਡੇਟਾ ‘ਤੇ ਕੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਵੇਗਾ। ਪਲੇਟਫ਼ਾਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਦਾਤਾ ਕੋਲ ਸਟੋਰ ਕੀਤਾ ਡੇਟਾ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਡਿਲੀਟ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ ਜਾਂ ਨਹੀਂ, ਇਹ ਸਮਝਣ ਲਈ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਉਸ ਪ੍ਰਦਾਤਾ ਦੀਆਂ ਸ਼ਰਤਾਂ, ਪਰਦੇਦਾਰੀ ਨੀਤੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਅਮਲ ਦੀ ਸਮੀਖਿਆ ਕਰਨੀ ਚਾਹੀਦੀ ਹੈ।

ਤੁਸੀਂ ਐਪੀਸੋਡ ਨੂੰ ਦੇਰ ਤੱਕ ਦਬਾ ਕੇ ਅਤੇ “ਵਾਚਲਿਸਟ ਤੋਂ ਹਟਾਓ” ਦੀ ਚੋਣ ਕਰ ਕੇ ਵਿਅਕਤੀਗਤ ਆਈਟਮਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੀ ਵਾਚਲਿਸਟ ਤੋਂ ਹਟਾ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ। ਇਸੇ ਹੀ ਮੈਨਿਊ ਵਿੱਚ, ਜੇਕਰ ਤੁਸੀਂ “ਹਾਲ ਹੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਦੇਖੇ ਗਏ ਤੋਂ ਹਟਾਓ” ਨੂੰ ਚੁਣਦੇ ਹੋ ਤਾਂ ਇਸ ਨਾਲ ਐਪੀਸੋਡ ਨੂੰ ਵਿਅਕਤੀਗਤ ਸਿਫ਼ਾਰਸ਼ਾਂ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਲਈ ਵਰਤੇ ਜਾਣ ਤੋਂ ਵੀ ਹਟਾ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਜਾਵੇਗਾ। ਹਾਲਾਂਕਿ Apple ਵੱਲੋਂ ਰਿਪੋਰਟਿੰਗ ਅਤੇ ਰਾਇਲਟੀ ਦੀਆਂ ਲੋੜਾਂ ਲਈ Apple TV ਚੈਨਲਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਚਲਾਉਣ ਦੀ ਹਿਸਟਰੀ ਅਤੇ ਤੁਹਾਡੀ Apple TV ਸਬਸਕ੍ਰਿਪਸ਼ਨ ਦੇ ਰਿਕਾਰਡ ਸਾਂਭ ਕੇ ਰੱਖੇ ਜਾਣਗੇ।

ਕਨੈਕਟ ਕੀਤੀਆਂ ਤੀਜੀ-ਧਿਰ ਦੀਆਂ ਐਪਾਂ

ਤੁਸੀਂ ਆਪਣੀਆਂ ਭਾਗੀਦਾਰ ਤੀਜੀ-ਧਿਰ ਦੀ ਐਪਾਂ ਨੂੰ Apple TV ਐਪ ਨਾਲ ਕਨੈਕਟ ਕਰਨ ਦੀ ਇਜਾਜ਼ਤ ਦੇ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ, ਤਾਂ ਜੋ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਐਪਾਂ ‘ਤੇ ਦੇਖੇ ਜਾਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਕੰਟੈਂਟ ਦੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ Apple ਨਾਲ ਸਾਂਝੀ ਕਰਨੀ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਾ ਸਕੇ। ਜਦੋਂ ਤੁਸੀਂ Apple TV ਐਪ ਦਾ ਸੈੱਟ ਅੱਪ ਕਰਦੇ ਹੋ ਤਾਂ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਇੱਕ ਹੀ ਸਮੇਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਈ ਐਪਲੀਕੇਸ਼ਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਇਜਾਜ਼ਤ ਦੇਣ ਲਈ ਕਿਹਾ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ। ਕੁਝ ਐਪਾਂ ਅਜਿਹੀਆਂ ਹੋ ਸਕਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ ਜਿਹਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਹਾਲੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਡਿਵਾਈਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਇੰਸਟਾਲ ਨਹੀਂ ਕੀਤਾ ਅਤੇ ਜੇਕਰ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਬਾਅਦ ਵਿੱਚ ਇੰਸਟਾਲ ਕਰ ਲਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਤੁਹਾਡੀਆਂ ਤਰਜੀਹਾਂ ਲਾਗੂ ਹੋ ਜਾਣਗੀਆਂ। ਤੁਸੀਂ ਸੈਟਿੰਗਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਹਰੇਕ ਐਪ ਲਈ ਆਗਿਆ ਦੇਣ ਜਾਂ ਨਾ ਦੇਣ ਦੀ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਰਜੀਹ ਨੂੰ ਬਦਲ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ।

ਜੇਕਰ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਕਿਸੇ ਵੀ ਸਮੇਂ ਇਹ ਫ਼ੈਸਲਾ ਕਰਦੇ ਹੋ ਕਿ ਹੁਣ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਆਪਣੀ ਕਿਸੇ ਵੀ ਤੀਜੀ ਧਿਰ ਦੀ ਐਪ ਨੂੰ Apple TV ਐਪ ਨਾਲ ਕਨੈਕਟ ਨਹੀਂ ਰੱਖਣਾ ਚਾਹੁੰਦੇ, ਤਾਂ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਉਸ ਐਪ ਨੂੰ Apple TV ਐਪ ਤੋਂ ਡਿਸਕਨੈਕਟ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ ਅਤੇ Apple ਵੱਲੋਂ ਉਸ ਤੀਜੀ ਧਿਰ ਦੀ ਐਪ ਦਾ ਚਲਾਉਣ ਸੰਬੰਧੀ ਡੇਟਾ ਇਕੱਠਾ ਕਰਨਾ ਬੰਦ ਕਰ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਜਾਵੇਗਾ। ਆਪਣੇ iOS, iPadOS ਜਾਂ visionOS ਡਿਵਾਈਸ ’ਤੇ Apple TV ਐਪ ਵਿੱਚ, ਖਾਤਾ > ਕਨੈਕਟ ਕੀਤੀਆਂ ਐਪਾਂ ’ਤੇ ਜਾਓ, ਤੀਜੀ-ਧਿਰ ਦੀ ਐਪ ਨੂੰ ਚੁਣੋ ਅਤੇ ਇਸ ਨੂੰ ਬੰਦ ਕਰ ਦਿਓ। tvOS ’ਤੇ, ਸੈਟਿੰਗਾਂ > ਐਪਾਂ > TV > TV ਨਾਲ ਕਨੈਕਟ ਕਰੋ ’ਤੇ ਜਾਓ, ਤੀਜੀ-ਧਿਰ ਦੀ ਐਪ ਨੂੰ ਚੁਣੋ ਅਤੇ ਇਸ ਨੂੰ ਬੰਦ ਕਰ ਦਿਓ। Apple TV ਐਪ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕਿਸੇ ਤੀਜੀ-ਧਿਰ ਦੀ ਐਪ ਨੂੰ ਹਟਾਉਣ ਵੇਲੇ “ਚਲਾਉਣ ਦੀ ਹਿਸਟਰੀ ਹਟਾਓ ਅਤੇ ਸਾਫ਼ ਕਰੋ” ਦਾ ਵਿਕਲਪ ਚੁਣ ਕੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਚਲਾਏ ਗਏ ਡੇਟਾ ਦੀ ਉਹ ਸਾਰੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਡਿਲੀਟ ਕਰਨ ਦੀ ਚੋਣ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ ਜੋ Apple ਨੇ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਉਸ ਐਪ ’ਤੇ ਦੇਖੇ ਗਏ ਕੰਟੈਂਟ ਦੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਵਜੋਂ ਇਕੱਤਰ ਕੀਤੀ ਸੀ। ਤੁਸੀਂ ਕਿਸੇ ਵੀ ਸਮੇਂ ਆਪਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ਚਲਾਉਣ ਸੰਬੰਧੀ ਡੇਟਾ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਨੂੰ ਡਿਲੀਟ ਕਰਨ ਦਾ ਵਿਕਲਪ ਚੁਣ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ, ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ Apple ਵੱਲੋਂ ਉੱਪਰ ਦੱਸੇ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਤੁਹਾਡੀ ਚਲਾਉਣ ਦੀ ਹਿਸਟਰੀ ਨੂੰ ਸਾਫ਼ ਕਰ ਕੇ ਤੀਜੀ ਧਿਰ ਦੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਕੰਟੈਂਟ ਸੰਬੰਧੀ ਇਕੱਠਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ, ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਤੁਸੀਂ Apple TV ਐਪ ਵਿੱਚ ਦੇਖਦੇ ਹੋ। ਇਹਨਾਂ ਦੱਸੀਆਂ ਗਈਆਂ ਉਦਾਹਰਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕਿਸੇ ਕਾਰਨ ਵੀ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਚਲਾਉਣ ਦੀ ਹਿਸਟਰੀ ਨੂੰ ਸਾਫ਼ ਕਰਨ ਨਾਲ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਤੀਜੀ ਧਿਰ ਦੀ ਐਪ ਦਾ ਉਹ ਡੇਟਾ ਸਾਫ਼ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਜੋ Apple TV ਐਪ ਲਈ Apple ਵੱਲੋਂ ਰੱਖਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਨਾਲ ਤੀਜੀ-ਧਿਰ ਦੇ ਐਪ ਪ੍ਰਦਾਤਾ ਕੋਲ ਵੱਖਰੇ ਤੌਰ ’ਤੇ ਸਟੋਰ ਕੀਤੇ ਕੰਟੈਂਟ ਚਲਾਉਣ ਸੰਬੰਧੀ ਡੇਟਾ (ਉਦਾਹਰਨ ਵਜੋਂ, ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦੀ ਆਪਣੀ ਐਪ ਵਿੱਚ ਜਾਂ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਸਰਵਰਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ) ’ਤੇ ਕੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵ ਨਹੀਂ ਪੈਂਦਾ।

ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੀਆਂ ਭਾਗੀਦਾਰ ਤੀਜੀ ਧਿਰ ਦੀਆਂ ਐਪਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਸ਼ਰਤਾਂ, ਪਰਦੇਦਾਰੀ ਨੀਤੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਅਮਲ ਦੀ ਸਮੀਖਿਆ ਵੀ ਕਰਨੀ ਚਾਹੀਦੀ ਹੈ, ਤਾਂ ਜੋ ਸਮਝਿਆ ਜਾ ਸਕੇ ਕਿ ਉਹ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਚਲਾਉਣ ਦੇ ਡੇਟਾ ਅਤੇ ਹੋਰ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਨੂੰ ਕਿਵੇਂ ਵਰਤਦੇ ਤੇ ਸਾਂਝਾ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ।

ਗਰੁੱਪ ਸਿਫ਼ਾਰਸ਼ਾਂ

ਜੇਕਰ ਤੁਸੀਂ Apple TV ਡਿਵਾਈਸ ’ਤੇ ਗਰੁੱਪ ਸਿਫ਼ਾਰਸ਼ਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਮਰੱਥ ਕਰਨ ਦੀ ਚੋਣ ਕਰਦੇ ਹੋ, ਤਾਂ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਜੋ ਕੁਝ ਦੇਖਦੇ ਹੋ, ਉਸ ਸੰਬੰਧੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ, ਉਸੇ Apple TV ’ਤੇ ਚੁਣੇ ਵਰਤੋਂਕਾਰ ਦੇ ਕਿਸੇ ਵੀ ਸੁਮੇਲ ਨਾਲ ਗਰੁੱਪ ਸਿਫ਼ਾਰਸ਼ਾਂ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਾਵੇਗੀ। ਜੇਕਰ ਬੱਚੇ ਦਾ ਖਾਤਾ ਗਰੁੱਪ ਵਿੱਚ ਹੈ, ਤਾਂ ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਲਈ ਸਿਫ਼ਾਰਸ਼ਾਂ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਕੀਤੀਆਂ ਜਾਣਗੀਆਂ, ਪਰ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਦੇਖੇ ਗਏ ਕੰਟੈਂਟ ਦੀ ਹਿਸਟਰੀ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਾਵੇਗੀ। ਤੁਸੀਂ ਆਪਣੇ ਖਾਤੇ ਲਈ ਗਰੁੱਪ ਸਿਫ਼ਾਰਸ਼ਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਕਿਸੇ ਵੀ ਸਮੇਂ ਬੰਦ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ। ਅਜਿਹਾ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਸੈਟਿੰਗਾਂ > ਵਰਤੋਂਕਾਰਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਖਾਤੇ ’ਤੇ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਪ੍ਰੋਫ਼ਾਈਲ ਚੁਣੋ, ਫਿਰ “ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਸਾਰਿਆਂ ਲਈ” ਚੁਣੋ।

ਧੋਖਾਧੜੀ ਅਤੇ ਹੋਰ ਸ਼ੱਕੀ ਗਤੀਵਿਧੀ ਨੂੰ ਰੋਕਣਾ

ਅਸੀਂ ਧੋਖਾਧੜੀ ਅਤੇ ਹੋਰ ਸ਼ੱਕੀ ਗਤੀਵਿਧੀ ਨੂੰ ਰੋਕਣ ਲਈ ਨਿੱਜੀ ਡੇਟਾ ਨੂੰ Apple TV ਐਪ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੀ ਇਕੱਤਰ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਾਂ। ਇਸ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਡਿਵਾਈਸ ਦੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਜਿਵੇਂ ਕਿ ਡਿਵਾਈਸ ਦੀ ਕਿਸਮ ਅਤੇ ਸੌਫ਼ਟਵੇਅਰ ਸੰਸਕਰਨ, ਟਿਕਾਣੇ ਸੰਬੰਧੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ (ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਇੰਟਰਨੈੱਟ ਕਨੈਕਸ਼ਨ ਦੇ IP ਪਤੇ ਦੇ ਲਗਭਗ ਭੂਗੋਲਿਕ ਖੇਤਰ ਨਾਲ ਮੇਲ ਕੇ, ਜੇਕਰ ਉਪਲਬਧ ਹੋਵੇ), ਡਾਊਨਲੋਡ ਅਤੇ ਖ਼ਰੀਦਦਾਰੀ ਦੀ ਹਿਸਟਰੀ ਅਤੇ Apple TV ਐਪ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਹੋਰ ਇੰਟਰੈਕਸ਼ਨ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਹੁੰਦੇ ਹਨ। ਜੇਕਰ ਤੁਹਾਡੀ ਸਬਸਕ੍ਰਿਪਸ਼ਨ ਨੂੰ ਸਵੈ-ਨਵੀਨੀਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਸੈੱਟ ਕੀਤਾ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ Apple ਤੁਹਾਡੇ Apple ਨਾਲ ਪੁਰਾਣੇ ਕਾਰੋਬਾਰੀ ਸੰਬੰਧਾਂ ਦੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਇਸ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਉੱਪਰ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ ਕਰਨ ਅਤੇ ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਭਾਈਵਾਲ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਣੀਕਰਨ ਕੀਤੇ ਜਾਣ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਤੁਹਾਡੀ ਸਬਸਕ੍ਰਿਪਸ਼ਨ ਨੂੰ ਐਕਸੈੱਸ ਪ੍ਰਦਾਨ ਕਰਨਾ ਜਾਰੀ ਰੱਖਣ ਦਾ ਫ਼ੈਸਲਾ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਕਰ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ।

ਜਦੋਂ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਖ਼ਰੀਦਦਾਰੀ ਕਰਨ ਦੀ ਕੋਸ਼ਿਸ਼ ਕਰਦੇ ਹੋ ਤਾਂ ਸਾਡੇ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਡਿਵਾਈਸ ’ਤੇ ਇੱਕ ਡਿਵਾਈਸ ਭਰੋਸੇਯੋਗਤਾ ਸਕੋਰ ਦਾ ਹਿਸਾਬ ਲਗਾਉਣ ਲਈ ਵੀ ਇਸ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਆਪਣੇ ਡਿਵਾਈਸ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕਿਸ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਕਰਦੇ ਹੋ, ਜਿਵੇਂ ਕਿ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਲਗਭਗ ਕਿੰਨੀਆਂ ਫ਼ੋਨ ਕਾਲਾਂ ਕਰਦੇ ਹੋ ਅਤੇ ਈਮੇਲਾਂ ਭੇਜਦੇ ਅਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤ ਕਰਦੇ ਹੋ। ਸਪੁਰਦਗੀ ਅਜਿਹੇ ਤਰੀਕੇ ਨਾਲ ਡਿਜ਼ਾਈਨ ਕੀਤੀ ਗਈ ਹੈ ਕਿ Apple ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਡਿਵਾਈਸ ‘ਤੇ ਅਸਲ ਮੁੱਲਾਂ ਦਾ ਪਤਾ ਨਾ ਲਗਾ ਸਕੇ। ਸਕੋਰ ਸਾਡੇ ਸਰਵਰ ‘ਤੇ ਨਿਸ਼ਚਿਤ ਸਮੇਂ ਲਈ ਸਟੋਰ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ।

ਨਿੱਜੀ ਡੇਟਾ ‘ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਲਾਗੂ ਕਾਨੂੰਨੀ ਆਧਾਰ

ਅਸੀਂ Apple TV ਐਪ ਵਿੱਚ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਨਿੱਜੀ ਡੇਟਾ ਨੂੰ ਆਮ ਤੌਰ ’ਤੇ Apple ਨਾਲ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਇਕਰਾਰਨਾਮੇ ਦੀ ਕਾਰਗੁਜ਼ਾਰੀ ਲਈ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ ਵਿੱਚ ਲੈ ਕੇ ਆਉਂਦੇ ਹਾਂ ਜੋ ਕਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਦਾਨ ਕਰਨ ਅਤੇ ਸਾਡੀਆਂ ਕਾਨੂੰਨੀ ਜ਼ਿੰਮੇਵਾਰੀਆਂ ਦੀ ਪਾਲਣਾ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਜ਼ਰੂਰੀ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ। ਜਿੱਥੇ ਸਹਿਮਤੀ ਢੁਕਵੇਂ ਕਾਨੂੰਨੀ ਆਧਾਰ ਵਜੋਂ ਹੋਵੇ, ਉੱਥੇ ਅਸੀਂ ਇਸ ਨੂੰ ਲਾਗੂ ਸਥਾਨਕ ਕਾਨੂੰਨ ਦੇ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਾਂ।

Macలోని Apple TV యాప్‌లో, TV > సెట్టింగ్స్ > ప్లేబ్యాక్‌కు వెళ్ళి, ఆపై ‘వీక్షణ చరిత్రను ఉపయోగించండి’ ఎంపికను తీసివేయండి.

మీరు మీ Apple ఖాతా కోసం Apple నుంచి వ్యక్తిగతీకరణ సిఫార్సులను ఆఫ్ చేయడం ద్వారా App Store, Apple Books, iTunes Store, Apple TV, Apple Podcasts మరియు సబ్‌స్క్రిప్షన్‌ల కోసం వ్యక్తిగతీకరణ ఫీచర్‌లను ఆఫ్ చేయవచ్చు. మీ iOS లేదా iPadOS లేదా visionOS డివైజ్‌లో, సెట్టింగ్స్ > [మీ పేరు] > మీడియా, కొనుగోళ్లు > ‘ఖాతాను చూడండి’కి వెళ్ళండి ఆ తర్వాత వ్యక్తిగతీకరించిన సిఫార్సులను ఆఫ్ చేయడానికి ట్యాప్ చేయండి.
